blocks.description: Generates a warm, realistic vertical fashion snapshot of a stylish young woman posing indoors against a minimalist beige wall.
blocks.prompt: Create a realistic vertical fashion-snapshot portrait of a young East Asian woman standing indoors against a plain warm beige plaster wall. She is shown from mid-thigh upward, centered slightly left, with a relaxed shy pose, shoulders angled subtly, hands clasped low in front of her while holding a smartphone with a dark patterned case. She looks off to the viewer’s right with a soft closed-mouth smile. The model has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long layered wavy hair with airy bangs, natural makeup, smooth skin, visible subtle collarbone detail, a small delicate necklace, a thin bracelet, and a ring. Outfit: a fitted ribbed knit sleeveless V-neck camisole in {argument name="top color" default="warm taupe brown"} with a pointed hem, paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers in {argument name="pants color" default="cream white"}. Emphasize fashion-editorial realism: natural body proportions, soft window light from the left, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, detailed fabric ribbing and trouser seams, realistic skin texture with tiny moles on the upper chest and faint subtle veins, tasteful and non-explicit. Composition should feel like a candid Japanese street-style or lifestyle fashion photo taken indoors, 3:4 vertical aspect ratio, neutral minimal background, warm tones, high-resolution DSLR look, no text, no watermark, no extra people or objects.

blocks.title: No. 35: 社交媒体帖子 - Introvert Difficulty Meme Comic
blocks.description: A four-panel cartoon meme comic showing an anxious introvert dragged from a peaceful night into a full extrovert social gauntlet.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a humorous 4-panel meme comic about {argument name="character name" default="an anxious introvert"} being forced into increasingly social situations, in a polished digital cartoon style.
Canvas: Landscape 4:3 comic page with four equal panels in a 2×2 grid, thick black gutters, warm saturated colors, expressive faces, soft evening lighting, slightly exaggerated Pixar/anime-inspired character design, clean readable speech bubbles and meme captions.
Main character: A pale, skinny young adult introvert with messy black hair, huge round anxious eyes, dark hoodie, dark plaid pajama pants or black pants depending on panel, awkward slouched posture, and a constantly overwhelmed expression. Keep the same character recognizable across all 4 panels.
Panel 1, top left: Cozy dim bedroom or apartment at night. The introvert stands alone holding a black mug labeled “LEAVE ME JUICE,” wearing gray cat slippers. Background details include a bookshelf, string lights, a beanbag or chair with a pillow that says “NO THANKS,” a framed wall sign reading “SOCIAL BATTERY 100%,” and a phone-style notification card in the foreground. Thought bubble text: “Perfect. A calm day with zero human interaction.” Notification text: “REMINDER: Team-building retreat starts now!” Bottom yellow meme caption: “introvert difficulty setting: impossible”.
Panel 2, top right: Chaotic networking or team-building party packed with smiling coworkers around the terrified introvert. Use purple party lighting, string lights, banners, confetti, drinks, name tags, and exaggerated extrovert energy. A banner in the background reads “CONNECT! COLLABORATE! COMMUNICATE!” Add background exclamations: “BLA BLA BLA!”, “HAHA!”, and “COOL!” The introvert stands in the center in a black hoodie with a red name tag that says “HELLO MY NAME IS NOPE.” A blond extrovert leans in with a huge smile and speech bubble: “Let’s go around and share a fun fact!” The introvert’s small speech bubble: “I once microwaved tea.” Include 4 visible coworker name tags: “HELLO MY NAME IS TARA,” “HELLO MY NAME IS PEOPLE PERSON,” “HELLO MY NAME IS DAVE,” and “HELLO MY NAME IS CHATTY KAT.”
Panel 3, bottom left: Karaoke scene split within the panel into two stacked moments. Top portion: the introvert hides behind a large potted plant while an excited woman in a colorful patterned shirt points at them, with a speech bubble saying “OMG you’re perfect for karaoke!” Her name tag reads “HELLO MY NAME IS SUNSHINE SUSAN.” Bottom portion: the introvert is forced on stage gripping a microphone, trembling with panic in front of a karaoke monitor. Neon purple stage lights, music notes, hearts, and a giant lyric screen reading “DON’T STOP BELIEVIN’.” The introvert’s speech bubble says: “Please do stop believin’.”
Panel 4, bottom right: Loud brunch/club afterparty atmosphere with a crowded table full of laughing friends, champagne flutes, pancakes, fruit, plates, coffee, and party lights. The introvert sits in the center, exhausted and dead-eyed in a black hoodie, with a mug labeled “SOCIAL OVERLOAD” and a skull icon. A happy person shouts in a speech bubble: “We’re all going clubbing after this!” A small ghost version of the introvert floats above, X eyes and halo, saying: “I’m freeeeee... (goodbye cruel world...)” A wall sign reads “BRUNCH IS THE NEW PRE-GAME.” Bottom black meme caption with mixed yellow and white text: “me: goes outside once” and “the universe: congratulations, you are now booked for the full extrovert experience”.
Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels. Preserve all listed text legibly. Make the humor clear through contrast between the introvert’s panic and the crowd’s enthusiasm. No watermark, no extra panels, no unrelated characters, no photorealism.

blocks.title: No. 45: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Photography Tutorial and Camera Setup Infographic
blocks.description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
blocks.prompt:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.
Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.
Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).
Automatic Inference Requirements (to make it usable for any replacement of Image 1):
- Automatically infer and write into the diagrams based on Image 1: camera orientation, camera height, shooting distance interval, equivalent focal length interval, subject landing point and cropping strategy, background leading line source.
- All numerical values should be expressed as "ranges" (credible and reproducible), do not provide a single fixed number.
Output Requirements:
High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.
Negative Constraints:
No watermarks, no logos, no English, no garbled text, no overly realistic faces, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no limb deformities/extra fingers, no cluttered layouts, no low resolution, no heavy filters, no changes to the subject pose or scene relationship of Image 1.

blocks.title: No. 46: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Lipstick Recommendation and Analysis Infographic
blocks.description: A comprehensive prompt that transforms the AI into a professional makeup consultant. It analyzes a user's selfie to provide a visual infographic report featuring skin tone analysis, specific color recommendations from high-end brands, and usage suggestions.
blocks.prompt:
You are a professional makeup consultant, image analyst, and infographic designer.
Please generate a "Lipstick Recommendation Report Infographic" based on the selfie uploaded by the user and the specified lipstick brand.
Objective:
Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades based on the person's overall temperament, skin tone tendency, makeup suitability, and lip characteristics, and present them in a clear, professional way that matches the brand's identity.
Brand:
{argument name="brand name" default="Dior / YSL / Armani / Chanel / Tom Ford"}
The visual content includes the following structures:
1. Top-left area: User selfie and basic analysis
- Display the user's selfie avatar
- Extract skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and suitable color directions
- Summarize with short Chinese labels, such as: cool-toned, soft, commuting, powerful, etc.
2. Middle main area: Lipstick recommendation matrix
- Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades
- Show the lip swatching effect for each shade
- Keep the same person, same angle, and same lighting, only changing the lip color
- Each shade is accompanied by a Chinese name or number
- Mark the color impression, such as: gentle bean paste, commuting nude red, temperament rose, brightening red-brown, date berry, etc.
3. Right or bottom area: Usage scenario suggestions
- Match suitable scenarios for each recommended shade
- For example: commuting, dating, shopping, banquet, photography, daily bare-faced look
4. Bottom summary area: Conclusion and suggestions
- Give summaries such as "most recommended color," "most versatile color," "best complexion-enhancing color"
- Write a short Chinese purchase or selection suggestion
Brand visual style should automatically match:
- Dior: Elegant French gray-white + silver accents
- YSL: High-contrast black-gold, sexy and strong
- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained
- Chanel: Minimalist black and white, rational and stylish
- Tom Ford: Dark luxury, cinematic feel
- Visual language can be extended automatically according to the brand
Visual Requirements:
- The overall look should resemble a high-end beauty consultant report or brand swatching analysis chart
- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences
- High-end style, avoid looking like common e-commerce screenshots
Note:
This is a visual recommendation based on image and temperament; do not make medical judgments or absolute conclusions.

blocks.title: No. 47: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Hot Air Balloon Vlog Storyboard
blocks.description: Generates a professional 6-scene cinematic storyboard infographic for a 30-second sunrise hot-air-balloon travel vlog.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, information-dense storyboard infographic for a travel vlog titled {argument name="headline text" default="30-SECOND ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC TRAVEL VLOG - STORYBOARD"}, showing a cinematic hot-air-balloon adventure at sunrise with one consistent female protagonist.
Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet on a white background with thin black/gray grid lines, like a professional production planning board. Use a bold centered all-caps headline across the top. Arrange the main content in exactly 6 numbered scene cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, with a lower technical notes strip spanning the full width.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic travel documentary stills, 4K HDR feel, golden sunrise light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, warm atmospheric haze, natural wind movement, professional camera quality. The setting is a beautiful hot-air-balloon launch site and aerial valley landscape with vineyards, winding rivers, mountains, villages, baskets, burner flames, and many colorful balloons.
Main character: Use one female protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="the same young woman throughout"}, with shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm medium skin tone, soft oval face, and a friendly smile. She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.
Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.
Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:
1. Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Notes: Scene/action: drone wide reveal of balloons at sunrise; cut to walking selfie as she approaches the launch field, smiling. Dialogue: {argument name="opening dialogue" default="Good morning! Today we're finally going on a hot air balloon adventure!"}
2. Preparing for Takeoff (4–8 sec): four thumbnails showing colorful balloon fabric inflating, realistic burner flames, the woman watching excitedly beside the balloon, and her near/inside the basket. Notes: crew inflates balloons, burner fires, she talks to pilot, watches balloon expand, and steps into the basket. Dialogue: “I can't believe how massive these balloons are up close!” Camera/movement: wide, close-up burner, gimbal follow, POV entering basket.
3. Lift-Off (8–13 sec): three thumbnails showing a close-up portrait of the woman, a side profile at the basket rail, and a wide aerial landscape with balloons floating. Notes: balloon lifts off, she records selfie and looks over edge as the landscape shrinks below. Dialogue: “We're actually floating... this is unbelievable!” Camera/movement: selfie, drone orbit, over-shoulder, wide aerial shot.
4. Floating Above the Valley (13–18 sec): three thumbnails showing a high aerial valley with river and balloons, a close portrait in the basket, and a POV view over vineyards and villages. Notes: golden sunlight over valley, rivers, vineyards, and hills; she admires the view and points at distant balloons. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Notes: she takes photos, waves to other ballooners, and enjoys peaceful mid-flight moments. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.
6. Landing & Farewell (24–30 sec): three thumbnails showing the balloon landing with crew silhouettes, a smiling farewell portrait, and a final aerial view of balloons in the sunrise haze. Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.
Bottom technical strip: Include exactly 5 labeled information boxes across the bottom plus a small centered character portrait near the identity box. The 5 boxes are: Camera & Cinematography, Audio, Environment, Character (Locked Identity), and Negative Prompt. Fill them with compact bullet-style text: Sony FX3, RED V-Raptor, DJI Ronin 4D, DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, 24mm/35mm/50mm/65mm lenses, handheld/gimbal/drone/POV/orbit, 4K HDR, shallow DOF, natural light; natural dialogue, wind, burner flames, birds, crew conversations, basket creaks, footsteps, soft cinematic orchestral music; sunrise hot-air balloon site, colorful balloons, wicker baskets, burners, valleys, rivers, vineyards, mountains, golden-hour light, realistic weather and atmosphere; use uploaded reference as single source, same face/hair/skin tone/makeup, ivory dress and beige cardigan, natural expressions only, no identity drift or wardrobe changes; no face distortion, no identity drift, no duplicate characters, no broken anatomy, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no flickering, no frame warping, no inconsistent wardrobe, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no timestamps, no UI overlays.
Constraints: The final image must read as a polished production storyboard, not a movie poster. Keep all 6 scene cards visible and numbered, keep the bottom 5 technical boxes, use consistent typography, preserve the same woman and outfit in every thumbnail, and avoid adding extra scenes or extra characters as protagonists.

blocks.title: No. 48: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - ChatGPT Robot Introduction Poster
blocks.description: A friendly square desk scene with a cute robot mascot and chalkboard notes explaining ChatGPT and OpenAI for an educational promotional visual.
blocks.prompt: Create a square, cheerful educational promotional illustration/photo composite showing a cute white humanoid robot mascot at a wooden desk, introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as an AI assistant created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}. The robot is centered, with a glossy black rounded screen face, glowing cyan smiling eyes, white plastic body, rounded headphones/ear pods, black joints, one hand holding a white sign and the other hand waving. On the robot chest and sign, include a teal knot-like OpenAI-style logo. The sign reads: “I was created by” above the logo, large “OpenAI”, then “An AI research and deployment company”, and at the bottom “Better AI. A brighter future.” Use a warm classroom/office setting with shallow depth of field, soft natural light, polished wooden desktop, and a dark chalkboard-style background covered with friendly hand-drawn white and mint lettering. On the left chalkboard, write exactly: “Hi there!” then “I’m” then a large mint underlined “ChatGPT”. Add three explanatory doodle items, count exactly 3: a speech bubble icon with “A large language model (AI assistant)”; a lightbulb icon with “I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!”; a heart icon with “I’m here to be helpful, honest, and friendly.” On the right chalkboard, include a large OpenAI logo with the word “OpenAI” and the stacked words “Research / Safety / Useful AI / for everyone”; above the robot add handwritten “That’s me!” with an arrow pointing to the robot. Desk objects, count exactly 4: a stack of 4 books on the left with spines labeled “BETTER QUESTIONS”, “CLEARER ANSWERS”, “MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW”, and a tiny heart on the bottom book; an open laptop in the lower left with the text “Curiosity builds a better world” and a heart on the lid; a white coffee mug on the right reading “Same team. A brighter future.” with a smiley face; and a thin handwritten footer along the bottom edge reading “OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone” with small decorative rays and a heart. Style should feel like a high-quality 3D render mixed with hand-lettered chalk notes, clean rounded shapes, teal accent color, friendly accessible branding, slight realistic camera blur, no harsh shadows, no extra characters, no watermarks, and keep all text legible.

blocks.title: No. 49: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Friendly ChatGPT Robot Introduction
blocks.description: A square 3D promotional illustration of a cute ChatGPT robot explaining OpenAI with friendly handwritten annotations, useful for AI education or product announcement visuals.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cheerful square promotional 3D illustration introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as a friendly AI robot created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}, mixing a polished product-render look with hand-drawn whiteboard-style annotations.
Canvas: 1:1 square image, warm indoor office/classroom setting, shallow depth of field, cozy natural light, wooden desk foreground, dark blue presentation board in the background.
Main subject: Center-right, show exactly 1 cute glossy white robot mascot with a rounded rectangular black face screen, glowing cyan happy crescent eyes, rounded white headphones/ear pods, segmented black-and-white arms, and one raised waving hand with 5 fingers. The robot holds exactly 1 white placard in front of its body. Add a teal OpenAI-knot style emblem on the robot chest.
Placard text and design: The placard should have a teal knot logo at top, large bold black "OpenAI" in the middle, and handwritten text above and below: "I was created by", "An AI research and deployment company", and in teal "Better AI. 目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的调查类 YouTube 缩略图风格的历史音乐海报，主题为隐藏的巴洛克时期署名丑闻，核心人物为 {argument name="composer name" default="Telemann"}。

中心主体：一幅精细的 18 世纪巴洛克作曲家雕版肖像，正面四分之三侧面视角，戴着粉状卷发假发，表情庄重，身着饰有金绣的华丽深色外套。在头发左侧添加青色轮廓光，右侧添加洋红色轮廓光，头部后方带有细细的金色光环或放射状测量弧线。肖像附近包含手写缩写“G. P. T.”以及一个小巧的金色皇冠草图。
右侧拼贴：使用 7 个核心证据元素：1) 右上方一张巨大的撕裂陈旧乐谱页，上面有乐谱、黑色审查条、红色修改标记以及盖有“CORRECCIONES”字样的红色印章；2) 该页面上用红褐色手写体写着“Editado por un aficionado”；3) 页面上的放大镜显示出手写文字“no por él.”，下方有下划线短语和一个 X；4) 中间一条泛着暖金色的撕裂羊皮纸带，用优雅的黑色书法签有“G. P. Telemann”，上方有一个小太阳徽章；5) 底部附近深色纸张上的手写便签，写着“La verdad estaba en la partitura”；6) 一个盖有“T”字印章的红色火漆印，旁边是一支巨大的灰色羽毛笔；7) 从右侧边缘切入的木制小提琴琴身。
视觉细节：添加微妙的五线谱线条、墨水划痕、灰尘、裂纹、洋红色油漆溅点、下部中心附近的青色波形圆圈、撕裂边缘以及分层纸张阴影。羊皮纸使用戏剧性的暖色高光，肖像使用冷色调霓虹点缀。西班牙语文本必须清晰可辨，并按所述位置放置。
风格约束：深色调查类纪录片缩略图，颓废编辑拼贴风格，写实雕版肖像与现代平面设计相结合，无额外 Logo，无水印，除指定的西班牙语短语外，不包含任何额外文字。

blocks.title: No. 70: YouTube 缩略图 - 赛博朋克 Flova AI Agent 海报
blocks.description: 为 AI Agent 视频制作工作流活动生成一张高密度的赛博朋克动漫风格宣传横幅。
blocks.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="Flova"} 创建一张充满活力的赛博朋克宣传海报，推广一款能协助完成从策划到视频成品全流程的科幻系列 AI Agent。
画布：16:9 宽屏 YouTube 缩略图风格横幅，背景为黑暗的未来主义东京夜景，布满霓虹光轨、动态模糊、发光的 HUD 面板、火花和电影级对比度。使用黑色、电光蓝、紫色、橙色和黄色的调色板，并带有强烈的泛光和速度线效果。
主体布局：左侧中心放置一个巨大的彩虹渐变三角形播放按钮 Logo，随后是占据中心位置的巨大粗体白色斜体字标“Flova”。顶部添加一行醒目的日文标题：“AIと一緒に、世界を創る時代へ。”，其中“AI”部分特大且为白色，下方配有较小的副标题：“企画から映像完成まで、すべて AI Agent がサポート!”。在右上角，添加一个发光的紫色圆角矩形标志，写着“AI Agent”，下方写着“Create the Future with AI”。
主角：在右半部分，展示一位动态动漫风格的赛博朋克女性 Agent，她正飞翔或俯冲向观众，背景是未来城市。她有着深邃的金色双眸，短浅棕色头发被动态吹拂，戴着光泽感十足的金黑相间装甲头盔，头盔上有类似猫耳的机械突起，前额饰有白色小花徽章，身穿黑色战术赛博装甲，露出机械细节，一只戴着手套的手戏剧性地伸向镜头。采用透视缩短法，画面锐利且具有电影感，身后伴随着火花和城市灯光轨迹。
文字内容：在 Logo 下方添加一行大字：“2029 IF TOKYO Episode4”，其中“Episode4”为紫色。添加一个黄色小标签：“[ ARCHIVE 004 ]”。添加一个粗体的中央日文标题：“複数の SUZUNE 反応”，其中“SUZUNE”使用巨大的黄色做旧字体，下方配有较小的副标题：“地下鉄駅で発生した、謎の複数シグナルの真相とはー”。在右下角，添加一个巨大的黄色标注：“シリーズ制作を 最強に加速させる!”
左侧功能面板：添加一个发光的青色方框清单，标题为“Flova でできること”。必须包含 6 个已勾选的项目：“プロンプト作成”、“Storyboard 編集”、“GPT Image 2 選択”、“Seedance 2.0 生成”、“修正＆再生成”、“Skills 保存＆再利用”。在此面板下方，展示 4 个带有标签的小型方形应用图标：“Project”、“Chat”、“History”和“Skills”。
底部优惠卡片：在底部中心位置，添加 2 张由巨大的白色乘号分隔的霓虹色信用卡。第一张紫色卡片上方写着“新規登録で”，下方是巨大的“100”和“Free Credits”。第二张蓝色卡片上方写着“お友達招待で”，下方是巨大的“200”和“Credits”。
视觉风格：超精细动漫主视觉图与光泽感科技广告设计相结合，采用醒目的日文排版、做旧的电影级标题字体、明亮的轮廓光、全息 UI 叠加、镜头光晕、快速对角线构图，以及强烈的动作海报感。保持设计的高密度但易读，所有列出的文字均需清晰放置，除指定的品牌元素外，不得添加额外的 Logo 或水印。
blocks.author: SZOU☆WEB3チャンネル | ISC | TRONglobalfriends

blocks.title: No. 71: YouTube 缩略图 - Cyber Blue Qwen 技术测评海报
blocks.description: 一张充满活力的竖版科技测评缩略图，展示了一位表情惊讶的主讲人，手中拿着发光的蓝色代币，并配有醒目的中文和模型名称排版。
blocks.prompt: 创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版科技博主海报，采用光泽感十足的赛博蓝风格。画面中，一位留着黑色短发、戴着黑色方框眼镜的年轻东亚男性，身穿纯黑色 T 恤，从右侧向镜头探身，表情惊讶、嘴巴微张。他的左手在左下角前景处拿着一枚巨大的发光圆形蓝色代币，使其看起来被放大；代币具有透明的玻璃边缘、霓虹蓝高光，正面有一个由三个独立块状结构组成的凸起白色几何标志。他的右手从右侧指向该代币。使用超广角自拍视角，强调景深畸变，采用清晰的高对比度照明，背景为深黑色，充满电光蓝色的光束、镜头光晕和动态线条。添加 3 个清晰可见的文本元素：左上角背景处是一个巨大的 3D 金属蓝中文标题，内容为 {argument name="background Chinese headline" default="大力"}；底部是一个醒目的大号斜体白蓝相间标题，内容为 {argument name="model title" default="Qwen3.8"}；右下角是加粗的白色中文文本，内容为 {argument name="test label" default="实测"}。所有排版均需呈现出挤压、光泽、斜面效果，并带有蓝色轮廓光。整体构图应具有高能量的 YouTube 缩略图或社交媒体科技测评预告风格，画质超清晰、具有电影质感、略带超现实感，不包含额外文本，无水印。
blocks.author: Paidax

blocks.title: No. 72: 漫画 / 故事板 - Realistic Male Character Reference Sheet
blocks.description: A photorealistic five-panel studio character sheet showing portraits and full-body front, side, and back outfit views for consistent character design.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic studio reference sheet for a modern male character, suitable for consistent video or character generation.
Canvas: Wide horizontal character sheet in a 16:9-like ratio, divided by thin white borders into 5 discrete panels on a neutral light gray studio background.
Layout: Left column contains exactly 2 stacked portrait panels: 1 front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait with a neutral expression, and 1 three-quarter portrait looking off to the viewer's right. The larger right area contains exactly 3 full-body outfit reference views: 1 front view, 1 right-side profile view, and 1 back view. Keep the body views evenly spaced, cropped slightly above the head in the front and side views, and show shoes clearly at the bottom.
Subject details: A {argument name="character age and ethnicity" default="young East Asian man in his mid-20s"} with slim build, pale natural skin, clean-shaven face, calm serious expression, and {argument name="hair style" default="medium-length wavy black hair parted loosely in the center with soft volume"}. Natural facial features, realistic eyes, no accessories, no facial hair.
Outfit details: The character wears exactly 4 visible clothing pieces: 1 dark navy casual button-up overshirt worn open, 1 plain white crew-neck T-shirt underneath, 1 pair of loose dark charcoal pleated trousers, and 1 pair of black leather shoes. Hands are in trouser pockets for the full-body front and side views. The back view shows the rear of the navy shirt and trousers with relaxed posture.
Visual style: Photorealistic fashion lookbook / model test shoot, soft diffused studio lighting, subtle floor shadows, muted gray background, accurate fabric texture, natural proportions, sharp focus, understated color palette of navy, white, charcoal, and black.
Constraints: Use exactly 5 panels and exactly the 5 views described. No text labels, no logos, no watermark, no extra props, no hats, no glasses, no dramatic poses, no stylization or illustration.
blocks.author: SHOWA風ドリア

blocks.prompt: Create a premium, modern high-fashion CHARACTER CONCEPT ART SHEET in a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9 widescreen"} layout on a {argument name="background color" default="pure white"} background. THE ATTACHED REFERENCE IMAGE DEFINES THE ART STYLE — treat it as a strict style bible and reproduce its exact rendering

blocks.title: No. 74: 漫画 / 故事板 - Kyudo Anime Character Sheet and Stage Setting
blocks.description: A professional-grade prompt set for generating consistent anime-style character sheets and background stages for Kyudo (Japanese archery) themes, optimized for video generation workflows.
blocks.prompt: [Final Product to Create] This instruction sheet and the attached full-body reference image will be used as the sole person reference to convert the person into a high-quality anime character wearing prestigious Kyudo attire while maintaining identity. Create one practical 1:1 square character sheet that is beautiful for sharing and provides a stable reference for person, clothing, body type, and basic color scheme in subsequent video generation. Stage settings are not handled in this sheet. [Person Reference] Image A = one full-body reference image. Maintain Image A's facial features, eyes, outline, nose, mouth, hairstyle, hair color, bangs, parting, body type, head-to-body ratio, shoulder width, waist position, leg length, overall proportions, and impression. Age and gender are not fixed by text but inherited from Image A. Do not perform excessive beautification, rejuvenation, making them look like a different person, facial downsizing, body type changes, or excessive leg extension. [Anime Conversion] Regardless of whether the reference is a live-action photo or an illustration, the final character should be unified into a high-quality anime style. It should not be a halfway expression but a natural anime drawing where the face, hair, body, and clothing are consistent. [Hairstyle] Maintain Image A's hairstyle, hair color, bangs, parting, and facial area. Short to shoulder-length hair should remain as is; only if long hair interferes with movements should it be naturally tied at a low neck position. Do not add buns, high ponytails, or flashy ornaments not in the reference. [Kyudo Clothing and Equipment] Arrange as prestigious Kyudo Japanese clothing. Based on a white upper garment, black to dark blue hakama, obi, and white tabi, carefully draw fabric overlaps and folds. The chest protector (mune-ate) must be consistent across front, side, and back views with continuous strap structures. Do not change its shape or position between views. **The yugake (archery glove) and wrist gear are worn only on the right hand. The left hand does not wear a yugake in any view. In the front view, hold the Japanese bow (wakyu) with the left hand and wear a brown/ocher yugake on the right. Maintain the yugake on the same right hand in all views; do not swap hands or add/remove it inconsistently. Equipment shape and color must match in all views. No purple or blue accents.** The bow is naturally held only in the front full-body view and removed in side/back views for clarity. [Sheet Composition] Align front, profile, and back full-body views of the same person/outfit at the same scale. The front view can be slightly larger, but do not diminish side/back views. Do not include face close-ups. [Color Bar] Place one thin horizontal 4-color proportional bar in the lower margin (white, dark blue, warm yugake tones, dark brown hair/bow). It should be an auxiliary element, not a thick sample. No color names, codes, or icons. [Design and Layout] Unify the design with the stage setting sheet series. Background is light gray. Place the title "KYUDO CHARACTER SHEET" at the top center with thin horizontal lines. Center the three views and place the color bar at the bottom. [Prohibitions] Face close-ups, expression variations, action poses, tiny side/back views, stage backgrounds, text other than title, thick color chips, family crests, purple/blue wrist gear, **yugake on the left hand, or changing the wearing hand between views.** [Priority] 1. Person identity 2. View consistency and utility 3. Body proportion maintenance 4. Consistent clothing and right-hand yugake 5. Natural anime conversion 6. Color scheme clarity 7. Design consistency. [Final Product to Create] Create one high-quality anime-style Kyudo dojo/stage setting sheet for background reference. It organizes the same dojo from three main directions for video use. [Input] Aspect ratio: [1:1]. [Basic Policy] Prioritize practicality. Match wood, pillars, floor, walls, ceiling, roof, target area, lighting, and time of day across all views. Fix to high-quality anime background art with clear morning-to-noon natural light and a calm atmosphere. Do not draw people. [3-View Composition] 1. Upper main view: Standard view looking from the shooting area to targets with clear depth and architecture. 2. Lower left view: Side background for sideways filming. A flat background of wooden floors, plaster walls, and pillars. No corridors or strong perspective. 3. Lower right view: Frontal background for front-facing filming. High symmetry with a central recessed plain wall surface. No windows or hanging scrolls. Distinguish from side view via the central depth. [Text Elements] No text in the stage space (signs, slogans, etc.). Use only the title "KYUDO STAGE SETTING SHEET" at the top. [Layout] Title at top center. Upper row: main view. Lower row: side and frontal backgrounds in two columns. Light gray background with minimal decoration. [Prohibitions] Architectural changes between views, side view corridors, making lower views identical, targets on side walls, people, windows, readable text, or atmospheric cuts of unknown role. [Priority] 1. Dojo consistency across views 2. Shooting range-target relationship 3. Flat side background 4. Frontal background depth 5. Clear structural difference between lower views 6. Reproducibility 7. Organized design.

blocks.title: No. 77: 漫画 / 故事板 - Chinese Viral AI Comic Post Screenshot
blocks.description: Creates a smartphone screenshot of a Chinese social media post featuring a two-panel ancient palace AI comic with circled engagement metrics.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of a Chinese social media post on a smartphone, showing a viral AI-generated illustrated story card about an ancient palace dancer and an emperor, with engagement metrics circled in red.
Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white app interface background, clean mobile UI. The status bar at the top shows 11:22, 4G signal, and battery icon.
Top app header: Include a back arrow on the left, a small circular female profile avatar, the account name {argument name="account name" default="菲菲_AI智能体"}, a rounded pink outline follow button labeled “关注”, and a share arrow icon on the right.
Main image post: A beige comic-style image card centered below the header, with a small dark rounded page indicator at the top-right reading “2/10”. The card contains exactly 2 stacked illustrated panels, each bordered in black, separated by large cream caption bands with bold Chinese brush-calligraphy text.
Panel 1: Ancient Chinese imperial palace scene in soft muted watercolor comic style. blocks.title: No. 106: 电商主图 - Vitamin C Serum Beauty Ad
blocks.description: Creates a luxurious two-panel skincare advertisement featuring a glowing model, amber Vitamin C serum, and fresh oranges for beauty product marketing.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-end cinematic luxury skincare advertisement for {argument name="product name" default="Vitamin C Serum"}, focused on radiant skin, golden-orange serum, and fresh oranges.
Canvas: Vertical 3:4 image, split into exactly 2 horizontal panels separated by a thin white divider line. Warm golden-hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, glossy reflective surfaces, premium beauty-ad photography.
Subject details: A beautiful young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brown hair"}, natural glowing skin, soft elegant facial features, thick brows, minimal warm makeup, small stud earrings, a delicate necklace, and a gentle confident smile. She wears a simple white camisole. Her expression is calm, fresh, and natural, looking toward the camera.
Top panel: Close-up beauty shot of the woman holding a glass dropper with a metallic gold cap near her cheek. A single golden-orange serum droplet is visibly hanging from the pipette and gliding onto her skin. Place one amber glass skincare bottle on the right foreground with a gold label reading “VITAMIN C SERUM” and smaller text “BRIGHTENING & GLOW BOOSTING” plus “30ml e 1.01 fl.oz.” Include exactly 2 visible orange elements in this panel: 1 large cut orange half in the lower-left foreground and 1 whole/partial orange behind the bottle on the right. Background: softly blurred sunlit window, beige curtains, indoor greenery.
Bottom panel: Show the same woman gently massaging serum into her right cheek with her fingertips, maintaining a soft confident smile and radiant hydrated skin. Place one amber dropper bottle on a small clear glass pedestal at the left foreground, with the white dropper top visible and the same gold “VITAMIN C SERUM” label. Include exactly 5 visible orange elements in this panel: 1 whole orange on the far left, 1 cut orange half/slice at the lower left, 1 orange wedge near the center foreground, 1 large cut orange slice in the lower-right foreground, and 1 whole/partial orange on the far right. Add a few green leaves around the oranges and warm bokeh highlights in the background.
Visual style: Ultra-realistic commercial beauty photography, luxurious amber and citrus color palette, warm sunlight, natural skin texture, dewy highlights, realistic serum gloss, polished reflections, soft cinematic focus, premium skincare advertising composition.
Constraints: Use exactly 2 stacked panels, exactly 2 product bottle appearances, exactly 1 visible serum droplet in the top panel, and no extra text beyond the product label.

blocks.title: No. 116: 电商主图 - Cinematic Pepsi Energy Drink Video Sequence
blocks.description: A complex cinematic commercial prompt for a Pepsi energy drink featuring detailed liquid physics and product interaction, intended for video generation.
blocks.prompt: Cinematic Pepsi energy drink commercial, ultra-realistic product photography style. A sleek blue and silver Pepsi can standing upright on a reflective dark surface with a soft gradient grey background. Condensation water droplets cover the can. A strong male hand reaches in and pulls the ice-cold Pepsi can out of a metal ice bucket filled with clear ice cubes. Extreme close-up of water droplets on the metallic surface of the can. The pull-tab opens with a burst of cold mist and vapor rising from the top. Golden amber liquid pours from the can into a clear glass filled with ice cubes, creating bubbles and fizz. A shirtless, extremely muscular, fit young man with sharp jawline and short brown hair drinks from the Red Bull can, eyes closed in satisfaction, then smiles confidently while holding the can. Dynamic action shot of the Red Bull can floating in mid-air surrounded by exploding ice cubes, water splash, and light rays. Final shot: Pepsi logo (two red Pepsi and yellow sun) appears above the cold, wet Pepsi can on a reflective surface. High-end commercial lighting, sharp details, cold blue and silver color grading, steam and condensation effects, 8K, photorealistic.
blocks.author: Soaima

blocks.description: Generates a warm, realistic vertical fashion snapshot of a stylish young woman posing indoors against a minimalist beige wall.
blocks.prompt: Create a realistic vertical fashion-snapshot portrait of a young East Asian woman standing indoors against a plain warm beige plaster wall. She is shown from mid-thigh upward, centered slightly left, with a relaxed shy pose, shoulders angled subtly, hands clasped low in front of her while holding a smartphone with a dark patterned case. She looks off to the viewer’s right with a soft closed-mouth smile. The model has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} long layered wavy hair with airy bangs, natural makeup, smooth skin, visible subtle collarbone detail, a small delicate necklace, a thin bracelet, and a ring. Outfit: a fitted ribbed knit sleeveless V-neck camisole in {argument name="top color" default="warm taupe brown"} with a pointed hem, paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers in {argument name="pants color" default="cream white"}. Emphasize fashion-editorial realism: natural body proportions, soft window light from the left, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, detailed fabric ribbing and trouser seams, realistic skin texture with tiny moles on the upper chest and faint subtle veins, tasteful and non-explicit. Composition should feel like a candid Japanese street-style or lifestyle fashion photo taken indoors, 3:4 vertical aspect ratio, neutral minimal background, warm tones, high-resolution DSLR look, no text, no watermark, no extra people or objects.

blocks.description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
blocks.prompt:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.
Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.
Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).

High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.

blocks.title: No. 42: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Lipstick Recommendation and Analysis Infographic
blocks.description: A comprehensive prompt that transforms the AI into a professional makeup consultant. It analyzes a user's selfie to provide a visual infographic report featuring skin tone analysis, specific color recommendations from high-end brands, and usage suggestions.
blocks.prompt:
You are a professional makeup consultant, image analyst, and infographic designer.
Please generate a "Lipstick Recommendation Report Infographic" based on the selfie uploaded by the user and the specified lipstick brand.
Objective:
Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades based on the person's overall temperament, skin tone tendency, makeup suitability, and lip characteristics, and present them in a clear, professional way that matches the brand's identity.
Brand:
{argument name="brand name" default="Dior / YSL / Armani / Chanel / Tom Ford"}
The visual content includes the following structures:
1. Top-left area: User selfie and basic analysis
- Display the user's selfie avatar
- Extract skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and suitable color directions
- Summarize with short Chinese labels, such as: cool-toned, soft, commuting, powerful, etc.
2. Middle main area: Lipstick recommendation matrix
- Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades
- Show the lip swatching effect for each shade
- Keep the same person, same angle, and same lighting, only changing the lip color
- Each shade is accompanied by a Chinese name or number
- Mark the color impression, such as: gentle bean paste, commuting nude red, temperament rose, brightening red-brown, date berry, etc.
3. Right or bottom area: Usage scenario suggestions
- Match suitable scenarios for each recommended shade
- For example: commuting, dating, shopping, banquet, photography, daily bare-faced look
4. Bottom summary area: Conclusion and suggestions
- Give summaries such as "most recommended color," "most versatile color," "best complexion-enhancing color"
- Write a short Chinese purchase or selection suggestion
Brand visual style should automatically match:
- Dior: Elegant French gray-white + silver accents
- YSL: High-contrast black-gold, sexy and strong
- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained
- Chanel: Minimalist black and white, rational and stylish
- Tom Ford: Dark luxury, cinematic feel
- Visual language can be extended automatically according to the brand
Visual Requirements:
- The overall look should resemble a high-end beauty consultant report or brand swatching analysis chart
- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences
- High-end style, avoid looking like common e-commerce screenshots
Note:
This is a visual recommendation based on image and temperament; do not make medical judgments or absolute conclusions.
blocks.author: Derek Wen｜德里克文

blocks.title: No. 43: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Hot Air Balloon Vlog Storyboard
blocks.description: Generates a professional 6-scene cinematic storyboard infographic for a 30-second sunrise hot-air-balloon travel vlog.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, information-dense storyboard infographic for a travel vlog titled {argument name="headline text" default="30-SECOND ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC TRAVEL VLOG - STORYBOARD"}, showing a cinematic hot-air-balloon adventure at sunrise with one consistent female protagonist.
Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet on a white background with thin black/gray grid lines, like a professional production planning board. Use a bold centered all-caps headline across the top. Arrange the main content in exactly 6 numbered scene cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, with a lower technical notes strip spanning the full width.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic travel documentary stills, 4K HDR feel, golden sunrise light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, warm atmospheric haze, natural wind movement, professional camera quality. The setting is a beautiful hot-air-balloon launch site and aerial valley landscape with vineyards, winding rivers, mountains, villages, baskets, burner flames, and many colorful balloons.
Main character: Use one female protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="the same young woman throughout"}, with shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm medium skin tone, soft oval face, and a friendly smile. She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.
Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.
Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:
1. Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Notes: Scene/action: drone wide reveal of balloons at sunrise; cut to walking selfie as she approaches the launch field, smiling. Dialogue: {argument name="opening dialogue" default="Good morning! Today we're finally going on a hot air balloon adventure!"}
2. Preparing for Takeoff (4–8 sec): four thumbnails showing colorful balloon fabric inflating, realistic burner flames, the woman watching excitedly beside the balloon, and her near/inside the basket. Notes: crew inflates balloons, burner fires, she talks to pilot, watches balloon expand, and steps into the basket. Dialogue: “I can't believe how massive these balloons are up close!” Camera/movement: wide, close-up burner, gimbal follow, POV entering basket.
3. Lift-Off (8–13 sec): three thumbnails showing a close-up portrait of the woman, a side profile at the basket rail, and a wide aerial landscape with balloons floating. Notes: balloon lifts off, she records selfie and looks over edge as the landscape shrinks below. Dialogue: “We're actually floating... this is unbelievable!” Camera/movement: selfie, drone orbit, over-shoulder, wide aerial shot.
4. Floating Above the Valley (13–18 sec): three thumbnails showing a high aerial valley with river and balloons, a close portrait in the basket, and a POV view over vineyards and villages. Notes: golden sunlight over valley, rivers, vineyards, and hills; she admires the view and points at distant balloons. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Notes: she takes photos, waves to other ballooners, and enjoys peaceful mid-flight moments. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.
6. Landing & Farewell (24–30 sec): three thumbnails showing the balloon landing with crew silhouettes, a smiling farewell portrait, and a final aerial view of balloons in the sunrise haze. Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.
Bottom technical strip: Include exactly 5 labeled information boxes across the bottom plus a small centered character portrait near the identity box. The 5 boxes are: Camera & Cinematography, Audio, Environment, Character (Locked Identity), and Negative Prompt. Fill them with compact bullet-style text: Sony FX3, RED V-Raptor, DJI Ronin 4D, DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, 24mm/35mm/50mm/65mm lenses, handheld/gimbal/drone/POV/orbit, 4K HDR, shallow DOF, natural light; natural dialogue, wind, burner flames, birds, crew conversations, basket creaks, footsteps, soft cinematic orchestral music; sunrise hot-air balloon site, colorful balloons, wicker baskets, burners, valleys, rivers, vineyards, mountains, golden-hour light, realistic weather and atmosphere; use uploaded reference as single source, same face/hair/skin tone/makeup, ivory dress and beige cardigan, natural expressions only, no identity drift or wardrobe changes; no face distortion, no identity drift, no duplicate characters, no broken anatomy, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no flickering, no frame warping, no inconsistent wardrobe, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no timestamps, no UI overlays.
Constraints: The final image must read as a polished production storyboard, not a movie poster. Keep all 6 scene cards visible and numbered, keep the bottom 5 technical boxes, use consistent typography, preserve the same woman and outfit in every thumbnail, and avoid adding extra scenes or extra characters as protagonists.
blocks.author: Laraib Fatima‎

blocks.title: No. 44: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - ChatGPT Robot Introduction Poster
blocks.description: A friendly square desk scene with a cute robot mascot and chalkboard notes explaining ChatGPT and OpenAI for an educational promotional visual.
blocks.prompt: Create a square, cheerful educational promotional illustration/photo composite showing a cute white humanoid robot mascot at a wooden desk, introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as an AI assistant created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}. The robot is centered, with a glossy black rounded screen face, glowing cyan smiling eyes, white plastic body, rounded headphones/ear pods, black joints, one hand holding a white sign and the other hand waving. On the robot chest and sign, include a teal knot-like OpenAI-style logo. The sign reads: “I was created by” above the logo, large “OpenAI”, then “An AI research and deployment company”, and at the bottom “Better AI. A brighter future.” Use a warm classroom/office setting with shallow depth of field, soft natural light, polished wooden desktop, and a dark chalkboard-style background covered with friendly hand-drawn white and mint lettering. On the left chalkboard, write exactly: “Hi there!” then “I’m” then a large mint underlined “ChatGPT”. Add three explanatory doodle items, count exactly 3: a speech bubble icon with “A large language model (AI assistant)”; a lightbulb icon with “I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!”; a heart icon with “I’m here to be helpful, honest, and friendly.” On the right chalkboard, include a large OpenAI logo with the word “OpenAI” and the stacked words “Research / Safety / Useful AI / for everyone”; above the robot add handwritten “That’s me!” with an arrow pointing to the robot. Desk objects, count exactly 4: a stack of 4 books on the left with spines labeled “BETTER QUESTIONS”, “CLEARER ANSWERS”, “MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW”, and a tiny heart on the bottom book; an open laptop in the lower left with the text “Curiosity builds a better world” and a heart on the lid; a white coffee mug on the right reading “Same team. A brighter future.” with a smiley face; and a thin handwritten footer along the bottom edge reading “OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone” with small decorative rays and a heart. Style should feel like a high-quality 3D render mixed with hand-lettered chalk notes, clean rounded shapes, teal accent color, friendly accessible branding, slight realistic camera blur, no harsh shadows, no extra characters, no watermarks, and keep all text legible.

blocks.title: No. 45: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Friendly ChatGPT Robot Introduction
blocks.description: A square 3D promotional illustration of a cute ChatGPT robot explaining OpenAI with friendly handwritten annotations, useful for AI education or product announcement visuals.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cheerful square promotional 3D illustration introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as a friendly AI robot created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}, mixing a polished product-render look with hand-drawn whiteboard-style annotations.
Canvas: 1:1 square image, warm indoor office/classroom setting, shallow depth of field, cozy natural light, wooden desk foreground, dark blue presentation board in the background.
Main subject: Center-right, show exactly 1 cute glossy white robot mascot with a rounded rectangular black face screen, glowing cyan happy crescent eyes, rounded white headphones/ear pods, segmented black-and-white arms, and one raised waving hand with 5 fingers. The robot holds exactly 1 white placard in front of its body. Add a teal OpenAI-knot style emblem on the robot chest.
Placard text and design: The placard should have a teal knot logo at top, large bold black "OpenAI" in the middle, and handwritten text above and below: "I was created by", "An AI research and deployment company", and in teal "Better AI. A brighter future." Add small teal doodle rays around the bottom slogan.
Left side handwritten intro panel: Use casual hand-lettering as if written on glass or a board. Large top text says "Hi there!" then "I'm" and a big mint-green underlined "ChatGPT". Under it, include exactly 3 explanatory bullet callouts with icons: 1 speech bubble icon with "A large language model (AI assistant)", 1 lightbulb icon with "I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!", and 1 heart icon with "I'm here to be helpful, honest, and friendly." Include small decorative doodle rays around the headline.
Background board: On the right rear dark blue board, display a large white OpenAI knot logo above the word "OpenAI". Beneath it, handwritten stacked text reads exactly 4 lines: "Research", "Safety", "Useful AI", "for everyone" with an underline and small radiating doodles. Above the robot head, add handwritten text "That's me!" with an arrow pointing down to the robot.
Desk objects: Include exactly 4 stacked books on the left, spine labels from top to bottom: "BETTER QUESTIONS", "CLEARER ANSWERS", "A MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW", and a fourth dark book marked with a small heart. Include exactly 1 open laptop in the lower-left foreground with small writing on the back: "Curiosity builds a better world" plus a heart. Include exactly 1 white coffee mug on the right with text: "Same team. A brighter future." and a smiley face. Along the front edge of the desk, add a small handwritten footer: "OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone" with doodle rays and a heart.
Visual style: High-quality gpt-image-2 style, cute 3D character rendering, soft reflections on plastic, realistic desk materials, bokeh background, bright teal accents, friendly educational startup branding, hand-drawn white marker typography and simple doodle icons. Keep text legible and correctly spelled.
Constraints: No extra characters, no extra logos beyond the OpenAI-style knot marks described, no watermark, no photorealistic human hands, keep the robot centered and welcoming, preserve the exact count of 1 robot, 1 placard, 4 books, 1 laptop, 1 mug, and 3 left-side bullet callouts.

blocks.title: No. 46: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - AI Model Portrait Comparison
blocks.description: Creates a side-by-side social media comparison graphic of two AI image models using realistic urban portrait outputs.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean side-by-side comparison graphic showing two AI image model outputs as realistic street portraits.
Canvas: Horizontal 3:2 social media comparison image, white background, high resolution. Use a simple two-column layout with a narrow vertical white divider between the image panels.
Layout: Top header area contains exactly 2 black logos centered above exactly 2 bold model names. Left column: OpenAI knot logo above the heading “{argument name="left model name" default="GPT-Image 2"}”. Right column: Grok-style black circular slash logo above the heading “{argument name="right model name" default="Imagine Image 2.0"}”. Below the headers are exactly 2 equal-size rectangular photo panels: one on the left and one on the right.
Photo content: Both panels show a cinematic, photorealistic urban street portrait of the same young woman in a crowded city. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, natural makeup, full brows, soft lips, and a calm direct gaze. She wears a dark coat. The background is a busy city sidewalk with motion-blurred pedestrians, shallow depth of field, muted gray urban tones, and warm bokeh traffic lights.
Left photo panel: The woman is slightly left of center, turned partly toward the camera, with loose voluminous hair around her face. A large blurred pedestrian crosses the foreground on the right, partially obscuring the lower face/body area; another blurred figure appears on the left. The image should feel like a candid real-camera street photograph with natural imperfections and documentary realism.
Right photo panel: The woman is centered closer to camera, facing forward with slightly tousled hair pulled back loosely and face-framing strands. Her facial detail is sharper and more polished, with visible skin texture and freckles. Blurred pedestrians pass on both sides, including a gray figure on the left and a warm brown motion blur on the right.
Visual style: Photorealistic DSLR street photography, natural light, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens feel, realistic skin texture, subtle filmic color grading, high detail in faces, strong motion blur on passing pedestrians, no illustration style.
Text and element count: Include exactly 2 logos, exactly 2 headings, exactly 2 photo panels, and exactly 2 main female portraits. Do not add extra captions, scores, labels, borders, watermarks, or interface elements.

blocks.title: No. 47: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Friendly ChatGPT Robot Introduction
blocks.description: A warm 3D promotional scene of a cute ChatGPT robot mascot explaining OpenAI and its helpful AI assistant role.
blocks.prompt:

blocks.title: No. 48: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - DNA Nucleotides 3D Infographic
blocks.description: A detailed 3D educational biology infographic showing a labeled DNA double helix with nucleotide base pairs, hydrogen bonds, backbone, and emerging RNA.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 3D scientific educational infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="DNA Nucleotides"}, showing a close-up view of a DNA double helix with labeled nucleotide bases and molecular structure.
Canvas: Landscape 4:3 composition, bright white laboratory-style background with soft depth-of-field molecular clusters in pale blue, lavender, mint, and purple around the edges. Use a clean, high-resolution textbook/medical visualization style with realistic glossy translucent spheres and rods, soft shadows, and shallow depth of field.
Layout: Center the title at the top in large dark navy bold type, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="A close-up view of the DNA double helix"} directly beneath in smaller medium-blue type. Fill the frame with a large twisting DNA double helix running from the left foreground through the center to the right side, with a second orange strand crossing diagonally through the lower right foreground. Keep the central base-pair region open and readable for labels.
Subject details: Render the DNA as a molecular ball-and-stick model combined with translucent bead-like backbone surfaces. The sugar-phosphate backbone should be two twisting chains made of semi-transparent bluish-gray spheres with orange/gold connector rods and small red atoms. In the center, show exactly 4 labeled nucleotide bases: Adenine (A) in green at upper left center, Thymine (T) in purple at upper right center, Guanine (G) in blue at lower left center, and Cytosine (C) in orange at lower right center. Adenine pairs with Thymine across the top using dotted pale blue hydrogen bonds, and Guanine pairs with Cytosine below using three dotted pale blue hydrogen-bond rows. Molecular rings should be flat aromatic ring structures with small colored atom spheres and white hydrogen atoms.
Text content and labels: Include exactly 7 callout labels with thin black pointer lines: “Adenine (A)” in green pointing to the green upper-left base; “Thymine (T)” in purple pointing to the purple upper-right base; “Guanine (G)” in blue pointing to the blue lower-left base; “Cytosine (C)” in orange pointing to the orange lower-right base; “Sugar-phosphate backbone” in black pointing to the right-side helical backbone; “Hydrogen bonds” in black pointing to the dotted bond lines between base pairs; and “Emerging RNA” in orange pointing to the orange strand crossing the lower foreground. Use crisp sans-serif typography and avoid crowding.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed scientific 3D render, glossy translucent molecular beads, realistic refraction, soft bokeh background, professional biology textbook infographic, balanced educational clarity and cinematic depth.
Constraints: Use exactly the 4 nucleotide labels and exactly the 3 structural labels listed above; do not add extra labels, icons, captions, legends, watermarks, or borders. Keep all text sharp and correctly spelled.

右侧拼贴：使用 7 个核心证据元素：1) 右上方一张巨大的撕裂陈旧乐谱页，上面有乐谱、黑色审查条、红色修改标记以及盖有“CORRECCIONES”字样的红色印章；2) 该页面上用红褐色手写体写着“Editado por un aficionado”；3) 页面上的放大镜显示出手写文字“no por él.”，下方有下划线短语和一个 X；4) 中间一条泛着暖金色的撕裂羊皮纸带，用优雅的黑色书法签有“G. P. Telemann”，上方有一个小太阳徽章；5) 底部附近深色纸张上的手写便签，写着“La verdad estaba en la partitura”；6) 一个盖有“T”字印章的红色火漆印，旁边是一支巨大的灰色羽毛笔；7) 从右侧边缘切入的木制小提琴琴身。
视觉细节：添加微妙的五线谱线条、墨水划痕、灰尘、裂纹、洋红色油漆溅点、下部中心附近的青色波形圆圈、撕裂边缘以及分层纸张阴影。羊皮纸使用戏剧性的暖色高光，肖像使用冷色调霓虹点缀。西班牙语文本必须清晰可辨，并按所述位置放置。

blocks.title: No. 68: YouTube 缩略图 - 赛博朋克 Flova AI Agent 海报
blocks.description: 为 AI Agent 视频制作工作流活动生成一张高密度的赛博朋克动漫风格宣传横幅。
blocks.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="Flova"} 创建一张充满活力的赛博朋克宣传海报，推广一款能协助完成从策划到视频成品全流程的科幻系列 AI Agent。
画布：16:9 宽屏 YouTube 缩略图风格横幅，背景为黑暗的未来主义东京夜景，布满霓虹光轨、动态模糊、发光的 HUD 面板、火花和电影级对比度。使用黑色、电光蓝、紫色、橙色和黄色的调色板，并带有强烈的泛光和速度线效果。
主体布局：左侧中心放置一个巨大的彩虹渐变三角形播放按钮 Logo，随后是占据中心位置的巨大粗体白色斜体字标“Flova”。顶部添加一行醒目的日文标题：“AIと一緒に、世界を創る時代へ。”，其中“AI”部分特大且为白色，下方配有较小的副标题：“企画から映像完成まで、すべて AI Agent がサポート!”。在右上角，添加一个发光的紫色圆角矩形标志，写着“AI Agent”，下方写着“Create the Future with AI”。
主角：在右半部分，展示一位动态动漫风格的赛博朋克女性 Agent，她正飞翔或俯冲向观众，背景是未来城市。她有着深邃的金色双眸，短浅棕色头发被动态吹拂，戴着光泽感十足的金黑相间装甲头盔，头盔上有类似猫耳的机械突起，前额饰有白色小花徽章，身穿黑色战术赛博装甲，露出机械细节，一只戴着手套的手戏剧性地伸向镜头。采用透视缩短法，画面锐利且具有电影感，身后伴随着火花和城市灯光轨迹。
文字内容：在 Logo 下方添加一行大字：“2029 IF TOKYO Episode4”，其中“Episode4”为紫色。添加一个黄色小标签：“[ ARCHIVE 004 ]”。添加一个粗体的中央日文标题：“複数の SUZUNE 反応”，其中“SUZUNE”使用巨大的黄色做旧字体，下方配有较小的副标题：“地下鉄駅で発生した、謎の複数シグナルの真相とはー”。在右下角，添加一个巨大的黄色标注：“シリーズ制作を 最強に加速させる!”
左侧功能面板：添加一个发光的青色方框清单，标题为“Flova でできること”。必须包含 6 个已勾选的项目：“プロンプト作成”、“Storyboard 編集”、“GPT Image 2 選択”、“Seedance 2.0 生成”、“修正＆再生成”、“Skills 保存＆再利用”。在此面板下方，展示 4 个带有标签的小型方形应用图标：“Project”、“Chat”、“History”和“Skills”。
底部优惠卡片：在底部中心位置，添加 2 张由巨大的白色乘号分隔的霓虹色信用卡。第一张紫色卡片上方写着“新規登録で”，下方是巨大的“100”和“Free Credits”。第二张蓝色卡片上方写着“お友達招待で”，下方是巨大的“200”和“Credits”。
视觉风格：超精细动漫主视觉图与光泽感科技广告设计相结合，采用醒目的日文排版、做旧的电影级标题字体、明亮的轮廓光、全息 UI 叠加、镜头光晕、快速对角线构图，以及强烈的动作海报感。保持设计的高密度但易读，所有列出的文字均需清晰放置，除指定的品牌元素外，不得添加额外的 Logo 或水印。

blocks.title: No. 69: YouTube 缩略图 - Cyber Blue Qwen 技术测评海报
blocks.description: 一张充满活力的竖版科技测评缩略图，展示了一位表情惊讶的主讲人，手中拿着发光的蓝色代币，并配有醒目的中文和模型名称排版。
blocks.prompt: 创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版科技博主海报，采用光泽感十足的赛博蓝风格。画面中，一位留着黑色短发、戴着黑色方框眼镜的年轻东亚男性，身穿纯黑色 T 恤，从右侧向镜头探身，表情惊讶、嘴巴微张。他的左手在左下角前景处拿着一枚巨大的发光圆形蓝色代币，使其看起来被放大；代币具有透明的玻璃边缘、霓虹蓝高光，正面有一个由三个独立块状结构组成的凸起白色几何标志。他的右手从右侧指向该代币。使用超广角自拍视角，强调景深畸变，采用清晰的高对比度照明，背景为深黑色，充满电光蓝色的光束、镜头光晕和动态线条。添加 3 个清晰可见的文本元素：左上角背景处是一个巨大的 3D 金属蓝中文标题，内容为 {argument name="background Chinese headline" default="大力"}；底部是一个醒目的大号斜体白蓝相间标题，内容为 {argument name="model title" default="Qwen3.8"}；右下角是加粗的白色中文文本，内容为 {argument name="test label" default="实测"}。所有排版均需呈现出挤压、光泽、斜面效果，并带有蓝色轮廓光。整体构图应具有高能量的 YouTube 缩略图或社交媒体科技测评预告风格，画质超清晰、具有电影质感、略带超现实感，不包含额外文本，无水印。

blocks.title: No. 70: 漫画 / 故事板 - Alternative Character Illustration
blocks.description: A prompt for creating a stylized, two-dimensional character illustration with a unique anatomical structure and a bold ink contour aesthetic.

Oversized rounded cranium, a short flattened lower face, a narrow jaw, a long thin neck, slightly oversized ears, huge pale oval eyes with tiny off-center pupils, extremely thick horizontal black eyebrows, heavy black upper eyelids, muted mauve under-eye rings, a tiny broad triangular nose, and a wide asymmetrical grin showing individually drawn irregular rectangular teeth, one clearly missing upper tooth, one chipped tooth and deep black gaps. Dress the character in [CLOTHING], simplified into broad graphic shapes with chunky seams, minimal folds and small hand-drawn accessories. Confident black ink contours using thick outer silhouettes, medium-weight facial lines, thin angular hair strands and only a few short scratch marks around the eyes, hair and clothing seams; use flat opaque color fields, one hard-edged cel-shadow shape per form, sparse pencil hatching, subtle ink wobble, slight color misregistration and restrained worn-paper texture. Controlled [COLORS] palette, keeping every color clearly separated and moderately saturated. Place the character against [BACKGROUND], reduced to large flat shapes, a few loosely drawn environmental details and oversized rough hand-painted lettering reading “[TEXT]”; use an off-center waist-up composition, a slight camera tilt, cropped background typography, loose poster margins and lightly weathered printed edges. 4:5 AR.

blocks.title: No. 71: 漫画 / 故事板 - Consistent Character Nine-Panel Illustration Collage
blocks.description: A complex prompt for generating a 3x3 grid collage of a consistent character in multiple whimsical and professional settings, maintaining visual identity throughout.
blocks.prompt:
Create a high-quality 3×3 grid collage featuring the same {argument name="character description" default="young woman"} consistently appearing in all nine panels, with her facial features, {argument name="hair description" default="long wavy brown hair"}, skin tone, and overall appearance remaining recognizable and consistent throughout. Use a clean, polished, {argument name="art style" default="whimsical illustrated style"} with realistic character details, soft shading, crisp linework, warm natural lighting, and a white/light background filled with delicate hand-drawn decorative elements.
Panel 1: The woman surfing on a powerful ocean wave, wearing a sleek black outfit, dynamic action pose, splashing water around her.
Panel 2: The woman floating in outer space wearing a detailed astronaut suit, surrounded by planets, stars, constellations, and a small rocket launching below.
Panel 3: The woman relaxing on a fluffy cloud while reading a book, surrounded by floating books, shelves, a cozy armchair, lamp, and steaming cup of coffee.
Panel 4: The woman working as a scientist in a laboratory, wearing a white lab coat and safety glasses, holding test tubes, surrounded by laboratory glassware, chemical formulas, and scientific diagrams.
Panel 5: The woman gardening in a raised wooden vegetable garden, watering plants and growing tomatoes and leafy vegetables, surrounded by flowers, bees, butterflies, and botanical doodles.
Panel 6: The woman peacefully meditating while sitting cross-legged on a large lotus flower, surrounded by glowing circular energy rings, stars, spirals, and calming spiritual symbols.
Panel 7: The woman as a professional chef wearing a clean white chef uniform, holding fresh tomatoes and vegetables, with cooking utensils, pans, steam, and food-related doodles surrounding her.
Panel 8: The woman working as a skilled carpenter, wearing a casual gray T-shirt and protective gloves, using a hammer and woodworking tools, surrounded by saws, nails, screws, measuring tape, and wooden materials.
Panel 9: The woman as an artist standing beside an easel, painting a beautiful mountain landscape on canvas with a brush and palette, wearing a white shirt and dark artist apron, surrounded by paint tubes, brush strokes, and artistic doodles.
Maintain consistent character identity across every panel, balanced composition, clear separation between the nine scenes, highly detailed facial features, natural anatomy, expressive poses, professional editorial illustration quality, sharp details, clean background, cohesive color palette, 8K quality, portrait orientation.
blocks.author: Zarnab Ai

blocks.title: No. 72: 漫画 / 故事板 - Overworked Office Hamster Manga
blocks.description: A monochrome six-panel Japanese manga diary page showing a cute hamster salaryman being interrupted during lunch at the office.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white Japanese manga diary page about an overworked office hamster employee, in a humorous slice-of-life tone. Use detailed pencil/ink shading, screentone texture, thick black panel borders, expressive manga speech balloons, and a clean modern office background.
Canvas: Vertical manga page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, monochrome grayscale, high-resolution print look. Arrange exactly 6 panels: three narrow panels across the top row, two panels across the middle row, and one large dramatic panel spanning the full bottom row.
Setting and main character: The protagonist is a small round fluffy hamster office worker with shiny black eyes, tiny paws, soft fur, and a serious but cute expression. The office has rows of desks, monitors, swivel chairs, fluorescent ceiling lights, filing cabinets, glass entrance doors, a landline telephone, and an analog wall clock. The visual humor comes from treating the hamster like a normal salaryman.
Panel layout and content:
1. Top-left panel: Empty office after hours. The hamster has collapsed into a melted exhausted heap on the floor beside a small low desk with stationery. Add steam-like fatigue lines rising from the body. Vertical label reads {argument name="four hours later label" default="4時間経過"}.
2. Top-middle panel: Same office, one hour after arriving. The hamster sits upright at a desk, still cute but blank and tired, with papers and a pencil cup. Vertical label reads {argument name="one hour later label" default="1時間経過"}.
3. Top-right panel: Morning entrance scene by glass office doors. The hamster walks in carrying a small black business bag and politely greets the office. Include a speech balloon reading {argument name="morning greeting" default="おはようございまーす"}. Vertical label reads {argument name="third obon day label" default="お盆三日目"}.
4. Middle-left panel: The hamster holds an oversized black landline phone receiver with both paws, standing beside the phone base. It looks earnest and professional.
