blocks.title: No. 101: 电商主图 - Traditional Stewed Pear Dessert Poster
blocks.description: A detailed macro photography prompt for a Chinese-style dessert poster featuring snow pears in a glass pot with warm morning light and elegant typography.
blocks.prompt: A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of translucent snow pear from a stewing pot, with clear syrup forming a small backflow along the tip of the spoon. Design a 3:4 vertical rock sugar stewed pear poster for an original nourishing dessert brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}". The scene is set exclusively on a warm white stone window sill on an autumn morning. A 15cm diameter transparent heat-resistant glass stewing pot is placed slightly to the right of the center, with the glass lid lying flat to the back left. The pot is 70% full of clear light-gold syrup, precisely containing eight pieces of cut snow pear, six pieces of transparent rock sugar, and three dried osmanthus flowers. A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of pear from the right, stopping about 4cm above the rim of the pot, with the syrup backflow controlled at 3cm. The center of the pot is at 62% horizontal and 64% vertical, occupying about 38% of the frame width. The area from 7% to 42% horizontal and 9% to 47% vertical on the left remains a warm white text zone. The foreground contains only half a fresh snow pear with the cut side facing up, while the background features a soft white sheer curtain; do not add red dates, wolfberries, or tremella. The camera is 12cm above the middle of the pot, using a 90mm macro lens shooting from the front left at a 14-degree angle from a distance of 72cm. The focus is locked on the pear fibers in the spoon, the transparency of the syrup, and the edge of the glass pot, with the lid remaining recognizable. A large window-shaped soft light of about 5500K from the back left penetrates the syrup and pear meat, while a warm white reflector at the front right restores the glass contours. Two strands of very faint steam rise towards the window. The color scheme is 52% warm white background, 18% transparent light-gold syrup, 20% pear milk white, 5% glass gray, and 5% dark brown text. Pear meat should be soft and slightly translucent but retain its chunk shape; syrup should be clear and low-viscosity, not a thick jam or milky soup. Text is limited to brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}", product name "{argument name="product name" default="Rock Sugar Stewed Pear"}", main copy "{argument name="main copy" default="Pear fragrance stewed slowly, sweetness falls clearly"}", and English sub-title "ROCK SUGAR STEWED PEAR". The main text on the left uses a dark brown fine Song font in three lines, brand name at the top, product name and English at bottom left. Lock one pot, one lid, eight pear chunks, six rock sugar pieces, three osmanthus flowers, one glass spoon, and back-left window light; do not add herbs, a second pot, excessive condensation, thick steam, or floating pear chunks.

blocks.prompt: ワードローブ： トップス： スタイリング： - フロントクロージャー：フロント中央のクロージャーの上部約3分の1だけを開け、胸より下のクロージャーはすべて裾まで留めたままにする。上部の開口部は左右対称に保つ。開口部を下部まで広げたり、上部を閉じ直したりしない。 - 袖：各袖口を外側にちょうど2回折り返し、両腕にダブルロールのバンドを作る。両方のバンドを前腕の中ほど、肘の折り目より下で手首より上の位置に配置する。他のスタイリング指示で衣服が肩から下がった場合でも、この巻き数と高さを維持する。袖を肘まで押し上げたり、袖口を隠したりしない。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル： - フロントクロージャー：選択した上部開口部のみを外し、下の留め具はすべて留めたままにする。その間隔を変更せず、固定された留め状態に隣接するパネルのドレープのみを調整する。 - 袖：選択した数、位置、向き、レイヤー順序を変更しない。固定された袖の高さより下のロール構造のみを調整し、元の袖口を保持する。適度な重なりとわずかな非対称性を持つ柔らかい折り目を使用する。 淡いスカイブルーと白の垂直ピンストライプの長袖クロップドボタンアップシャツ。軽量なポプリン風の織物で、パリッとしたマットな質感。ボクシーなシルエットで、ウエストより上で終わる裾を持つ。白いポインテッドカラーと、小さな白いボタンが並ぶフロント前立てを備える。袖山に軽いギャザーがあり、広いピンストライプのバレルカフスはボタンで閉じられている。左胸にパッチポケットがあり、全体に白い植物風の刺繍やオープンワークが施されている。左胸ポケットには、半透明の花びらのアップリケやビーズを用いた立体的な装飾が集中している。ジッパーや余計な装飾のない、一貫したデザインのシャツである。 ボトムス：淡いクールグレーのハイライズフレアミニスカート。中重量のコンパクトなポンチニット製で、マットな質感。太もも上部丈のスケーターシルエット。伸縮性のあるアッパーバンドを備え、複数のパネルとシームラインで構成されている。ポケットやジッパーのないプルオンタイプで、素材の厚みと放射状のフレアを維持している。 レッグウェア：温かみのある白のショートクルーソックス。上質な垂直リブニット製で、左右対称の設計。リブ編みのアッパーカフと補強されたかかと・つま先を持ち、装飾のないシンプルなデザイン。適度な不透明度とストレッチ性を備えている。 フットウェア：温かみのあるアイボリーのロートップチャンキーレザースニーカー。丸いつま先と厚いプラットフォームソールが特徴。アッパーはスエード調の素材とオフホワイトのメッシュを組み合わせ、幾何学的なオーバーレイを配置。オフホワイトの靴紐が左右対称に通されている。頑丈なラグトレッドを備えた厚底ソールを持ち、細部まで一貫した配色と質感で仕上げられている。 バッグ： スタイリング： - バッグの持ち方：ストラップを左肩からのみ下げ、バッグ本体を左脇腹に置く。胸を横切らせず、手は添えない。バッグとストラップは衣服の外側に完全に露出させ、衣服の下や中を通さないこと。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル：選択したストラップのルートに沿って、素材に忠実な緩みと体への接触のみを調整する。選択したルートとすべての取り付けを維持する。

blocks.title: No. 115: 电商主图 - 禅意乌龙茶电商详情页
blocks.description: 一份精心设计的提示词，旨在为概念茶品牌生成高端移动端优先的电商详情页，遵循具有禅意美学的结构化客户转化路径。
blocks.prompt:
为概念品牌“{argument name="brand name" default="LANXU"}”设计一个高端移动端优先的电商详情页，针对“{argument name="product name" default="高山乌龙茶"}”打造完整的转化路径。该产品为两罐装礼盒，每罐净含量为“{argument name="net content" default="100g"}”。
严格保持一致性：品牌“LANXU”，两罐圆柱形金属茶罐（高约 135mm，直径 78mm），采用岩灰色哑光饰面，配以古铜色盖子。垂直品牌标识“LANXU”和产品标签在两个罐子上必须完全一致。视觉系统：“禅意奢华 + 自然有机”，核心概念“杯中云雾”。配色方案：岩灰、雾白、芽绿、琥珀茶色和氧化铜色。图形语言：抽象的山谷轮廓、稀薄的晨雾和扩散的茶汤层次。排版：现代宋体搭配简洁的无衬线字体，留白充裕。
布局：宽度约 1242px，垂直长图（比例 1:5）。包含七个连续模块：
1. “核心价值”：两罐茶叶与礼盒置于抽象的云雾山谷背景中，标题为“杯中云雾”。
2. “饮用价值”：干茶、叶底和清澈琥珀茶汤的微距摄影，标注“风味特征：以实际测评为准”。
3. “产地与原料”：抽象的茶园坡地与采摘细节，预留产地和海拔信息位置。
4. “制作工艺”：四个步骤（采摘、萎凋、烘焙、包装），预留工艺名称位置。
5. “冲泡体验”：白瓷盖碗、公道杯和注茶的写实场景；预留温度和时间信息位置。
6. “包装与规格”：清晰展示礼盒、两罐茶叶、开启状态及“100g x 2 罐”标签。
7. “购买信任”：礼赠场景、规格占位符及物流信息。
风格：结合真实商业摄影与精致平面设计的高端电商艺术指导。所有物品必须具备真实的比例和接触点。茶叶不得悬浮，雾气不得遮挡产品可见度。
仅展示核心文本：“LANXU”、“高山乌龙”、“杯中云雾”、“原叶形态”、“风味特征：占位符”、“产地信息：占位符”、“工艺信息：占位符”、“冲泡建议：占位符”、“100g x 2 罐”、“产品信息：占位符”。

blocks.title: No. 34: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Dark UI Character Sheet Evaluation
blocks.description: Generates a Japanese dark-mode comparison dashboard for evaluating character-sheet creation routes from a reference image.
blocks.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the source material, create a dark-mode Japanese evaluation report slide that compares attempts to generate a character sheet while preserving the same rough watercolor/ink illustration style.
Goal: Turn the reference into a structured experiment-summary dashboard titled 「M2　ステップ2—ムードボードを見本に GPT でキャラクターシート」. Keep the subject as the small armored child character from the reference, but present the result as an analysis screen rather than a single illustration.
Canvas and style: Use a wide 16:9 dark UI layout with charcoal background, thin dividers, rounded cards, small Japanese UI text, orange/green accent labels, and embedded white image panels. Make it look like a screenshot of an internal comparison report.
Top section: Create exactly 3 comparison cards across the top. Each card contains a white character-sheet panel showing the same character in multiple views and a small detached head/bust crop. Use these card titles and edge scores:
1. 「経路A：GPT ムードボード経由」 with 「エッジ 57.6」
2. 「経路B：grok ムードボード経由」 with 「エッジ 52.6」
3. 「参考：grok キャラ直接（B-5）」 with 「エッジ 48.8」
Under each card add one short Japanese note line; the third card should mention that it is the softest and inherits the sample’s green cloth.
Middle section: Add a comparison table with exactly 4 columns labeled 「条件」, 「エッジ強度」, 「コントラスト」, 「見本の欠陥」. Include exactly 7 data rows:
1. 「grok（目標）」 — 47.2 — 82.4 — 「—」
2. 「1) 共通のみ」 — 53.6 — 90.8 — 「—」
3. 「2) + 筆致（言葉）」 — 52.0 — 88.4 — 「なし」
4. 「3) + grok キャラ見本」 — 「48.8 ← 最良」 — 85.4 — 「緑の布を継承」
5. 「4) + GPT ムードボード」 — 「57.6 ← 最悪」 — 84.5 — 「なし」
6. 「5) + grok ムードボード」 — 52.6 — 87.3 — 「なし」
7. 「素材 image3.png（参考）」 — 58.8 — 69.1 — 「—」
Bottom section: Add several short Japanese conclusion lines beginning with 「結論1」 through 「結論5」, explaining that moodboard routes are not very effective, direct character reference works better, and the practical workaround is to avoid moodboards and use the Grok output with cropping. Finish with a collapsible dark bar labeled 「プロンプト（ステップ2の冒頭：ムードボードの役割指定）」.
Constraints: Preserve the character identity and rough painted look from REFERENCE_0 in the embedded panels, but do not recreate the full original reference screenshot. Do not add unrelated characters. Use crisp UI typography and readable Japanese labels. The main title topic may be customized as {argument name="report title" default="M2　ステップ2—ムードボードを見本に GPT でキャラクターシート"}; the three route labels may be customized as {argument name="route labels" default="経路A：GPT ムードボード経由 / 経路B：grok ムードボード経由 / 参考：grok キャラ直接（B-5）"}; the character-sheet subject may be customized as {argument name="character subject" default="the small armored child knight from the reference"}; the table metric emphasis may be customized as {argument name="best and worst edge notes" default="48.8 ← 最良, 57.6 ← 最悪"}.

blocks.title: No. 37: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Photography Tutorial and Camera Setup Infographic
blocks.description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
blocks.prompt:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.
Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.
Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).
Automatic Inference Requirements (to make it usable for any replacement of Image 1):
- Automatically infer and write into the diagrams based on Image 1: camera orientation, camera height, shooting distance interval, equivalent focal length interval, subject landing point and cropping strategy, background leading line source.
- All numerical values should be expressed as "ranges" (credible and reproducible), do not provide a single fixed number.
Output Requirements:
High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.
Negative Constraints:
No watermarks, no logos, no English, no garbled text, no overly realistic faces, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no limb deformities/extra fingers, no cluttered layouts, no low resolution, no heavy filters, no changes to the subject pose or scene relationship of Image 1.

blocks.title: No. 38: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Lipstick Recommendation and Analysis Infographic
blocks.description: A comprehensive prompt that transforms the AI into a professional makeup consultant. It analyzes a user's selfie to provide a visual infographic report featuring skin tone analysis, specific color recommendations from high-end brands, and usage suggestions.
blocks.prompt:
You are a professional makeup consultant, image analyst, and infographic designer.
Please generate a "Lipstick Recommendation Report Infographic" based on the selfie uploaded by the user and the specified lipstick brand.
Objective:
Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades based on the person's overall temperament, skin tone tendency, makeup suitability, and lip characteristics, and present them in a clear, professional way that matches the brand's identity.
Brand:
{argument name="brand name" default="Dior / YSL / Armani / Chanel / Tom Ford"}
The visual content includes the following structures:
1. Top-left area: User selfie and basic analysis
- Display the user's selfie avatar
- Extract skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and suitable color directions
- Summarize with short Chinese labels, such as: cool-toned, soft, commuting, powerful, etc.
2. Middle main area: Lipstick recommendation matrix
- Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades
- Show the lip swatching effect for each shade
- Keep the same person, same angle, and same lighting, only changing the lip color
- Each shade is accompanied by a Chinese name or number
- Mark the color impression, such as: gentle bean paste, commuting nude red, temperament rose, brightening red-brown, date berry, etc.
3. Right or bottom area: Usage scenario suggestions
- Match suitable scenarios for each recommended shade
- For example: commuting, dating, shopping, banquet, photography, daily bare-faced look
4. Bottom summary area: Conclusion and suggestions
- Give summaries such as "most recommended color," "most versatile color," "best complexion-enhancing color"
- Write a short Chinese purchase or selection suggestion
Brand visual style should automatically match:
- Dior: Elegant French gray-white + silver accents
- YSL: High-contrast black-gold, sexy and strong
- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained
- Chanel: Minimalist black and white, rational and stylish
- Tom Ford: Dark luxury, cinematic feel
- Visual language can be extended automatically according to the brand
Visual Requirements:
- The overall look should resemble a high-end beauty consultant report or brand swatching analysis chart
- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences
- High-end style, avoid looking like common e-commerce screenshots
Note:
This is a visual recommendation based on image and temperament; do not make medical judgments or absolute conclusions.

blocks.title: No. 39: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Hot Air Balloon Vlog Storyboard
blocks.description: Generates a professional 6-scene cinematic storyboard infographic for a 30-second sunrise hot-air-balloon travel vlog.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, information-dense storyboard infographic for a travel vlog titled {argument name="headline text" default="30-SECOND ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC TRAVEL VLOG - STORYBOARD"}, showing a cinematic hot-air-balloon adventure at sunrise with one consistent female protagonist.
Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet on a white background with thin black/gray grid lines, like a professional production planning board. Use a bold centered all-caps headline across the top. Arrange the main content in exactly 6 numbered scene cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, with a lower technical notes strip spanning the full width.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic travel documentary stills, 4K HDR feel, golden sunrise light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, warm atmospheric haze, natural wind movement, professional camera quality. The setting is a beautiful hot-air-balloon launch site and aerial valley landscape with vineyards, winding rivers, mountains, villages, baskets, burner flames, and many colorful balloons.
Main character: Use one female protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="the same young woman throughout"}, with shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm medium skin tone, soft oval face, and a friendly smile. She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.
Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.
Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:
1. Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Notes: Scene/action: drone wide reveal of balloons at sunrise; cut to walking selfie as she approaches the launch field, smiling. Dialogue: {argument name="opening dialogue" default="Good morning! Today we're finally going on a hot air balloon adventure!"}
2. Preparing for Takeoff (4–8 sec): four thumbnails showing colorful balloon fabric inflating, realistic burner flames, the woman watching excitedly beside the balloon, and her near/inside the basket. Notes: crew inflates balloons, burner fires, she talks to pilot, watches balloon expand, and steps into the basket. Dialogue: “I can't believe how massive these balloons are up close!” Camera/movement: wide, close-up burner, gimbal follow, POV entering basket.
3. Lift-Off (8–13 sec): three thumbnails showing a close-up portrait of the woman, a side profile at the basket rail, and a wide aerial landscape with balloons floating. Notes: balloon lifts off, she records selfie and looks over edge as the landscape shrinks below. Dialogue: “We're actually floating... this is unbelievable!” Camera/movement: selfie, drone orbit, over-shoulder, wide aerial shot.
4. Floating Above the Valley (13–18 sec): three thumbnails showing a high aerial valley with river and balloons, a close portrait in the basket, and a POV view over vineyards and villages. Notes: golden sunlight over valley, rivers, vineyards, and hills; she admires the view and points at distant balloons. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Notes: she takes photos, waves to other ballooners, and enjoys peaceful mid-flight moments. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.
6. Landing & Farewell (24–30 sec): three thumbnails showing the balloon landing with crew silhouettes, a smiling farewell portrait, and a final aerial view of balloons in the sunrise haze. Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.
Bottom technical strip: Include exactly 5 labeled information boxes across the bottom plus a small centered character portrait near the identity box. The 5 boxes are: Camera & Cinematography, Audio, Environment, Character (Locked Identity), and Negative Prompt. Fill them with compact bullet-style text: Sony FX3, RED V-Raptor, DJI Ronin 4D, DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, 24mm/35mm/50mm/65mm lenses, handheld/gimbal/drone/POV/orbit, 4K HDR, shallow DOF, natural light; natural dialogue, wind, burner flames, birds, crew conversations, basket creaks, footsteps, soft cinematic orchestral music; sunrise hot-air balloon site, colorful balloons, wicker baskets, burners, valleys, rivers, vineyards, mountains, golden-hour light, realistic weather and atmosphere; use uploaded reference as single source, same face/hair/skin tone/makeup, ivory dress and beige cardigan, natural expressions only, no identity drift or wardrobe changes; no face distortion, no identity drift, no duplicate characters, no broken anatomy, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no flickering, no frame warping, no inconsistent wardrobe, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no timestamps, no UI overlays.
Constraints: The final image must read as a polished production storyboard, not a movie poster. Keep all 6 scene cards visible and numbered, keep the bottom 5 technical boxes, use consistent typography, preserve the same woman and outfit in every thumbnail, and avoid adding extra scenes or extra characters as protagonists.

blocks.title: No. 44: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - DNA Nucleotides 3D Infographic
blocks.description: A detailed 3D educational biology infographic showing a labeled DNA double helix with nucleotide base pairs, hydrogen bonds, backbone, and emerging RNA.

Use crisp sans-serif typography and avoid crowding.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed scientific 3D render, glossy translucent molecular beads, realistic refraction, soft bokeh background, professional biology textbook infographic, balanced educational clarity and cinematic depth.
Constraints: Use exactly the 4 nucleotide labels and exactly the 3 structural labels listed above; do not add extra labels, icons, captions, legends, watermarks, or borders. Keep all text sharp and correctly spelled.

blocks.title: No. 66: YouTube 缩略图 - 赛博朋克 Flova AI Agent 海报
blocks.description: 为 AI Agent 视频制作工作流活动生成一张高密度的赛博朋克动漫风格宣传横幅。
blocks.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="Flova"} 创建一张充满活力的赛博朋克宣传海报，推广一款能协助完成从策划到视频成品全流程的科幻系列 AI Agent。
画布：16:9 宽屏 YouTube 缩略图风格横幅，背景为黑暗的未来主义东京夜景，布满霓虹光轨、动态模糊、发光的 HUD 面板、火花和电影级对比度。使用黑色、电光蓝、紫色、橙色和黄色的调色板，并带有强烈的泛光和速度线效果。
主体布局：左侧中心放置一个巨大的彩虹渐变三角形播放按钮 Logo，随后是占据中心位置的巨大粗体白色斜体字标“Flova”。顶部添加一行醒目的日文标题：“AIと一緒に、世界を創る時代へ。”，其中“AI”部分特大且为白色，下方配有较小的副标题：“企画から映像完成まで、すべて AI Agent がサポート!”。在右上角，添加一个发光的紫色圆角矩形标志，写着“AI Agent”，下方写着“Create the Future with AI”。
主角：在右半部分，展示一位动态动漫风格的赛博朋克女性 Agent，她正飞翔或俯冲向观众，背景是未来城市。她有着深邃的金色双眸，短浅棕色头发被动态吹拂，戴着光泽感十足的金黑相间装甲头盔，头盔上有类似猫耳的机械突起，前额饰有白色小花徽章，身穿黑色战术赛博装甲，露出机械细节，一只戴着手套的手戏剧性地伸向镜头。采用透视缩短法，画面锐利且具有电影感，身后伴随着火花和城市灯光轨迹。
文字内容：在 Logo 下方添加一行大字：“2029 IF TOKYO Episode4”，其中“Episode4”为紫色。添加一个黄色小标签：“[ ARCHIVE 004 ]”。添加一个粗体的中央日文标题：“複数の SUZUNE 反応”，其中“SUZUNE”使用巨大的黄色做旧字体，下方配有较小的副标题：“地下鉄駅で発生した、謎の複数シグナルの真相とはー”。在右下角，添加一个巨大的黄色标注：“シリーズ制作を 最強に加速させる!”
左侧功能面板：添加一个发光的青色方框清单，标题为“Flova でできること”。必须包含 6 个已勾选的项目：“プロンプト作成”、“Storyboard 編集”、“GPT Image 2 選択”、“Seedance 2.0 生成”、“修正＆再生成”、“Skills 保存＆再利用”。在此面板下方，展示 4 个带有标签的小型方形应用图标：“Project”、“Chat”、“History”和“Skills”。
底部优惠卡片：在底部中心位置，添加 2 张由巨大的白色乘号分隔的霓虹色信用卡。第一张紫色卡片上方写着“新規登録で”，下方是巨大的“100”和“Free Credits”。第二张蓝色卡片上方写着“お友達招待で”，下方是巨大的“200”和“Credits”。
视觉风格：超精细动漫主视觉图与光泽感科技广告设计相结合，采用醒目的日文排版、做旧的电影级标题字体、明亮的轮廓光、全息 UI 叠加、镜头光晕、快速对角线构图，以及强烈的动作海报感。保持设计的高密度但易读，所有列出的文字均需清晰放置，除指定的品牌元素外，不得添加额外的 Logo 或水印。

blocks.title: No. 67: YouTube 缩略图 - Cyber Blue Qwen 技术测评海报
blocks.description: 一张充满活力的竖版科技测评缩略图，展示了一位表情惊讶的主讲人，手中拿着发光的蓝色代币，并配有醒目的中文和模型名称排版。
blocks.prompt: 创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版科技博主海报，采用光泽感十足的赛博蓝风格。画面中，一位留着黑色短发、戴着黑色方框眼镜的年轻东亚男性，身穿纯黑色 T 恤，从右侧向镜头探身，表情惊讶、嘴巴微张。他的左手在左下角前景处拿着一枚巨大的发光圆形蓝色代币，使其看起来被放大；代币具有透明的玻璃边缘、霓虹蓝高光，正面有一个由三个独立块状结构组成的凸起白色几何标志。他的右手从右侧指向该代币。使用超广角自拍视角，强调景深畸变，采用清晰的高对比度照明，背景为深黑色，充满电光蓝色的光束、镜头光晕和动态线条。添加 3 个清晰可见的文本元素：左上角背景处是一个巨大的 3D 金属蓝中文标题，内容为 {argument name="background Chinese headline" default="大力"}；底部是一个醒目的大号斜体白蓝相间标题，内容为 {argument name="model title" default="Qwen3.8"}；右下角是加粗的白色中文文本，内容为 {argument name="test label" default="实测"}。所有排版均需呈现出挤压、光泽、斜面效果，并带有蓝色轮廓光。整体构图应具有高能量的 YouTube 缩略图或社交媒体科技测评预告风格，画质超清晰、具有电影质感、略带超现实感，不包含额外文本，无水印。
blocks.author: Paidax

blocks.title: No. 68: 漫画 / 故事板 - Polished Anime Noble Portrait
blocks.description: Transforms a rough character sketch into a finished regal anime bust portrait with ornate jewelry, costume details, and preserved handwritten name/title text.
blocks.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the character base, transform the rough pencil sketch into a polished, high-resolution anime character concept portrait. Preserve the same bust-up 3/4 head angle, calm serious expression, neck length, updo hairstyle silhouette, loose side locks, and the handwritten name/title placement on the left.
Rendering style: clean modern anime illustration with crisp line art, soft cel shading, glossy highlights, detailed eyes, and a plain white background. Replace the sketch lines with finished color artwork.
Character finish: give the character {argument name="hair color" default="deep ruby red"} hair, vivid {argument name="eye color" default="green"} eyes, fair skin, refined eyelashes, and a composed noble look.
Costume and accessories: redesign the simple neckline into an ornate imperial high collar with cream fabric, gold filigree embroidery, and white lace ruffles. Add exactly 3 visible red gemstone accessories: 1 elaborate gold-and-red hair ornament on the bun, 1 dangling red gemstone earring, and 1 oval red gemstone brooch at the collar. Make the gold details intricate and regal but keep the original portrait composition uncluttered.
Text: convert the rough handwritten notes into stylized dark red calligraphy on the left, preserving exactly 2 text blocks: {argument name="character name" default="Mariel Trust"} near the upper left and {argument name="title text" default="Ice Emperor"} near the lower left. Do not add any other text.
Constraints: keep the crop close to the original bust portrait, keep the background blank white, avoid changing the face direction or expression, and make the final image look like a finished character sheet illustration rather than a sketch.
blocks.author: 썰렁황제

blocks.title: No. 69: 漫画 / 故事板 - Handcrafted 3D Paper-Craft Travel Diorama
blocks.description: Creates charming 3D paper-craft dioramas of travel scenes, perfect for storybook aesthetics and nostalgic miniature art.
blocks.prompt:
Create a premium handcrafted 3D paper-craft travel diorama centered around a little girl and her beloved doll on a magical journey.
adorable young girl doll character sitting on the upper edge of the diorama with her favorite small doll companion beside her. She wears a charming vintage travel outfit — a soft knitted cardigan, pleated skirt, little boots, cute hat, and a tiny backpack. She holds a miniature travel journal or map, while her doll is dressed in a matching outfit and carries a tiny suitcase.
The main scene inside the dimensional frame should represent {argument name="destination" default="Paris"} as a magical miniature world. Include its most recognizable architecture and landscapes, but reinterpret everything as handcrafted toys and paper sculptures: tiny buildings, colorful streets, flowers, trees, bridges, cafés, lanterns, local decorations, and a small pathway leading into the scene.
Add charming storytelling details:
The girl’s doll sitting beside her as her travel companion
Tiny suitcase covered with travel stickers
Miniature teddy bear peeking from the backpack
A tiny camera hanging around the girl’s neck
Small postcards and stamps scattered around the frame
A miniature paper airplane flying through the scene
A tiny map with a dotted route
Handcrafted flowers and plants around the foreground
Use a soft pastel vintage palette of dusty pink, warm cream, terracotta, muted teal, sage green, peach, and warm brown.
The entire artwork should feel like a luxury handcrafted children’s storybook mixed with a vintage travel scrapbook, using layered cardstock, paper quilling, embossed paper, miniature clay details, fabric textures, stitched leather accents, and delicate hand-painted surfaces.
Make the girl and her doll especially charming and expressive, with a cute collectible-doll aesthetic, oversized curious eyes, soft handcrafted facial details, and a warm adventurous personality.
Add a large raised plaque at the bottom reading:
{argument name="destination" default="Paris"}
{argument name="country" default="France"}
Surround the composition with subtle travel elements such as a compass, postage stamps, luggage tags, leaves, postcards, and a dotted travel route.
Soft warm studio lighting, realistic miniature shadows, tactile paper fibers, shallow depth of field, premium product photography, highly detailed handcrafted textures, whimsical cinematic atmosphere, elegant composition, cozy nostalgic feeling, museum-quality miniature diorama, 8K.
Avoid: photorealistic humans, plastic-looking 3D characters, excessive text, clutter, harsh colors, modern objects, generic fantasy scenery.
blocks.author: simeon-sanai

blocks.title: No. 70: 漫画 / 故事板 - Oriental Papercut Art of Sacred Temple Bridge
blocks.description: A sophisticated prompt for generating a three-dimensional layered papercut illustration, depicting a woman crossing a celestial bridge toward a glowing paper temple with intricate carving textures.
blocks.prompt: 9:16 vertical version, modern oriental female dreamscape 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, epic oriental papercraft fantasy, poetic female dreamscape, contemporary oriental art poster. The theme of the work is 'She crosses a suspended sky bridge towards the center of the temple.' The core narrative of the scene is: a young oriental woman alone embarks on a long paper-art sky bridge floating above a sea of clouds, with a giant glowing paper-sculpture temple at the end of the bridge. She moves forward step by step, finally deciding to enter the center that only appeared in her dreams. The entire scene emphasizes a pilgrimage-like sense of progression, a vast high-altitude world, and the epic momentum of a paper-art mythological scene. The main character is an adult oriental woman with a visual age of about 25, bright, brave, quiet, and firm, with a sense of solemnity when facing the unknown temple. The character has a soft oval face, clear almond eyes, and gazes intently at the distant temple with a calm and determined expression. The character is not the main large-scale close-up of the scene but an emotional anchor in a huge world, and the proportions must be significantly small. Character hairstyle and headwear: long black hair naturally loose, the ends of the hair blown by the wind into slender flowing paper ribbons, wearing light gold leaves and small star-shaped hair accessories. The headwear is exquisite and light, not complex or tall. The long hair and silk drape extend behind her in the high-altitude wind, forming clear and elegant flowing lines. Character clothing: a layered paper-art long skirt in moon white and cyan-green, the hem unfolded in layers of leaves and cloud patterns, the silk drape slender and light, partially with light gold hollowed patterns. The clothing must have a multi-layered paper structure, fine hollowed edges, paper fibers, slight creases, real paper thickness, and a high-degree of handmade cutting feel. The hem and drape extend in the wind on the bridge, but do not block the perspective direction of the bridge. The dream carrier is: a suspended paper-art sky bridge. Dream imagery includes: sky bridge, cloud sea, temple, flying birds, distant mountains, glowing cloud layers. All bridges, temples, clouds, mountains, birds, and characters must be unified in a high-quality 3D paper sculpture language; realistic characters with paper-cut backgrounds or ordinary CG architecture are not allowed. The overall paper-cut structure adopts: a surrounding dreamscape style. Composition and camera requirements: the camera is located on the bridge surface, using a low-angle or eye-level shot, high-angle top-down shots cannot be used. The line of sight extends along the bridge surface toward the distant temple, forming a strong single-point perspective and epic depth. The sky bridge extends from the foreground at the bottom of the screen to the far center, leading directly to the temple. The bridge width is moderate but visually extremely long, with exquisite hollowed railings, suspension chains, carvings, and paper-art components on both sides. The character is located in a small position in the middle-lower part of the bridge, facing away from or semi-facing away from the camera, walking towards the distant temple. The character must be significantly smaller than the bridge and the temple to highlight the oppressive sense of the scene and the scale of the bridge. The main subject of the scene is an extremely long and narrow suspended paper-art sky bridge. The bridge body floats above an infinite sea of clouds, and the bridge surface is composed of silver-white, moon-white, and light-gold details, with rich oriental hollowed patterns, paper-sculpted railings, layered structures, and translucent edges. The bridge is not an ordinary small bridge but like a sacred bridge leading to the center of a divine realm, with exaggerated length and strong depth, making the viewer feel the distance and the sense of high-altitude danger. In the distance is a huge, multi-layered glowing paper-sculpted temple. The volume of the temple is much larger than the person and even much larger than the bridge entrance porch, possessing a clear sense of oppression and divine scale. The temple is composed of multiple halls, arches, towers, corridors, and a central glowing entrance, with a complex and exquisite structure, layered and situated between the sea of clouds and the mountains. There is a glowing doorway or main hall entrance at the center of the temple, becoming the final visual focus. The temple should be like the ultimate center in a dream, not a common courtyard building. On both sides of the bridge are a huge sea of clouds and high-altitude white space. The sea of clouds is composed of a large number of paper layers of different thicknesses, forming surging layers and a massive sense of volume. Distant paper-art mountains rise from the clouds, the peaks are cyan and misty blue, with fine gold-line hollowed decorations. A few birds may fly by in the high sky to enhance the sense of scale and airspace, but do not stack too many. The overall color scheme is: moon white, cyan-green, silver white as primary colors, with a small amount of light gold accents. Moon white is used for the bridge body, bright parts of the temple, outer layers of character clothing, and highlights of the sea of clouds; cyan-green is used for distant mountains, inner layers of clothing, and partial decorations; silver white is used for temple highlights, bridge surface highlights, and the sky atmosphere; light gold is only used for railing chains, hollowed patterns, clothing outlines, and partial highlights. The overall look must be bright, transparent, and clear, not gray, not darkened, not overall blueish, and not yellowish. Light and paper texture: bright daylight with a blend of cold and warm tones at high altitude illuminates the sky bridge and the temple, the edges of the bridge surface are slightly translucent, the shadow layers of the temple paper are clear, and the paper fibers and layered structures are exquisite and obvious. The distant temple entrance emits a soft but strong light, extending toward the foreground along the bridge. The bridge railings, character's shoulders, hair strands, and skirt edges have soft rim lighting. The paper surface must have clearly visible fiber textures, manual cutting marks, slight creases, layered shadows, and translucent edges, overall looking like a high-quality museum-grade paper sculpture art installation. blocks.title: No. 92: 产品营销 - Pistachio Crochet Cardigan and Plaid Mini Dress
blocks.description: A complex outfit prompt detailing the textures of a crochet cardigan paired with a multiscale plaid skater dress featuring lace trim.
blocks.prompt: Wardrobe: Outerwear / layers: One solid pistachio short-sleeve crochet cardigan built from fine softly matte yarn. Upper-hip length with a close straight body, lightly shaped waist, and two independent front panels. A deep rounded V opening continues into narrow scalloped front bands. Two short set-in sleeves have compact fitted upper sections, softly expanded lower edges, and narrow scalloped cuffs. The body and sleeves use a consistent openwork construction of slim vertical chain ladders alternating with dense shell-like crochet columns, preserving small irregular apertures and a clearly fibrous looped surface. A narrow scalloped crochet border completes the neckline, both front edges, cuffs, and lower hem. Five evenly spaced pistachio four-hole buttons run down one front band, with aligned crochet buttonholes on the opposite band; all five buttons remain released. Keep the open cells distinct, the shell columns vertically coherent, the front panels balanced, the buttons flat and evenly aligned, and the soft yarn texture clean rather than fuzzy or melted together. Dress / all-in-one: One olive-green, smoky-charcoal, muted-lavender, beige, and black spaghetti-strap mini dress made from lightweight fine-gauge semi-sheer mesh with soft fluid drape. Across the complete plaid shell, an all-over oblique multiscale check places broad smoky-charcoal bands, narrower muted-lavender bands, and fine beige lines over an olive ground, creating a regular field of unequal rectangular cells with stable band order and crisp intersections. The dress is close through the shaped bust and waist, then widens immediately below the fitted waist into a full upper-thigh-length skater skirt with rounded fluid flare and unpleated volume. The front upper edge forms a deep sweetheart V from two shaped bust panels, while the rear upper edge follows a low soft curve. Shaped front, side, and rear bodice panels continue below the curved underbust line, and the fitted torso releases into the full bias-cut skirt with evenly distributed soft folds. Two very narrow constant-width straps join the upper front corners to corresponding rear anchors. Black scalloped floral lace traces the complete bust edge and rear upper edge; a broader black scalloped lace band follows the curved underbust seam, with a compact flat black ribbon knot at the center front. A narrow black mesh binding finishes the full undulating hem. Elastic recovery in the lace bands and pliant bias mesh forms a clean pull-on closure with a continuous fitted upper circuit. The rear lace edge and underbust band continue uninterrupted between the paired strap anchors, and the checked skirt retains its full flare across the rear. Preserve the fine mesh grain, slight translucency through single layers, denser tone at overlaps, delicate lace openwork, crisp scallops, slim seam allowances, stable check-band widths, and thin flexible edge depth throughout. Footwear: One matching pair of solid dark brown platform Mary Jane shoes built from smooth low-luster structured upper material with shallow natural creasing, clean rounded edge returns, and dense molded dark brown rubber at the base. Each shoe has a broad rounded-square overall front envelope and a low substantial platform profile. The low upper opening has a shallow curved rear arc and continues forward into two narrow transverse unfilled instep slots. A broad rounded-square closed toe box and low side quarters form the upper, while a one-piece platform sole follows the full perimeter, projects slightly beyond the toe and sides, and combines a softly rounded sidewall with a nearly level lower profile and a low integrated heel. One wide flat crosswise instep strap spans between the two open slots and anchors directly into both side quarters. The anatomical mirror counterparts use identical toe width, opening geometry, strap position, upper-panel seams, platform depth, and edge finish. Keep the toe boxes broad but not bulbous, the strap planes flat, the instep slots sharply bounded, the upper surfaces smooth, and the sole sidewalls dense and cleanly molded. Belt: Styling: - Belt placement: Place the complete belt as one flat diagonal closed circuit on the outermost surface of Mini dress, with the wearer-left upper-hip side distinctly lower than the wearer-right side. Maintain the same wearer-left-downward diagonal across the front and back; do not mirror it to image-left or twist the band. Preserve any separately selected buckle or knot position and tail treatment, and do not invent unregistered hardware. One pistachio crochet cord belt built from a long slender round braided cord and a dimensional yarn rosette. The flexible cord forms one complete adjustable circuit and retains a consistently narrow circular section. A large rosette is constructed from three concentric tiers of tightly crocheted scalloped petals around a compact spiral center. blocks.title: No. 93: 产品营销 - Futuristic VTuber Debut Poster
blocks.description: A vibrant anime VTuber teaser poster featuring a silver-haired idol reaching toward the viewer in a neon futuristic city.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a glossy VTuber-style teaser key visual for a futuristic idol debut, centered on {argument name="character name" default="Amaha Mirai"}, with strong character presence and high-energy anime advertising design.
Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, full bleed, ultra-detailed anime illustration, vibrant cyan, electric blue, magenta, lavender, and white lighting, sparkling bloom effects, clean commercial finish.
Layout: Put a huge glowing Japanese title across the top reading {argument name="main title text" default="天羽ミライ"}, with small spaced roman letters above it reading “AMAHA MIRAI”. Center-right foreground shows the VTuber idol reaching one hand toward the viewer in dynamic perspective. The background is a bright futuristic city canyon with holographic billboards and glass skyscrapers. Across the lower middle, add a glowing slogan line reading {argument name="slogan text" default="きらめく未来に、ログイン。"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller launch notice reading {argument name="launch text" default="近日始動"}, framed by tiny star symbols and decorative sci-fi divider lines.
Subject details: Draw one cheerful young anime idol girl with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="silvery white with pale blue and pink highlights"} hair, large blue-violet eyes, open smiling mouth, soft blush, and a headset microphone. She wears a futuristic cropped idol jacket in white and pastel blue with pink accents, star pins, metallic trims, a short layered translucent skirt, belts, straps, and iridescent fabric details. Add hair accessories: exactly 3 visible accessories — one large bow-and-ribbon ornament on the right side of her head, one small star clip near the left bangs, and two small pink hairpins grouped on the right bangs as a single accessory cluster.
Background elements: Include exactly 5 prominent futuristic promotional elements — one giant holographic billboard on the left showing the same idol with “LIVE” styling, one small flying camera drone near the upper-left sky, one central needle-like tower, one neon triangular sign in the lower-left corner, and one bright holographic sign on the right building. Fill the scene with pink flower-petal confetti, star sparkles, lens flares, and light streaks.
Visual style: Modern Japanese anime poster, high-saturation cyber-pop city, luminous rim lighting, crisp linework, detailed hair strands, polished VTuber debut advertisement aesthetic, energetic perspective, dreamy yet sharp.
Constraints: Keep the image as a single poster, no extra characters, no logo watermark, make all text large and decorative but legible, preserve the Japanese text exactly as specified in the slots, and avoid cluttering the face or outstretched hand with text.

blocks.title: No. 94: 产品营销 - Ultra-Premium Cinematic Sports Glitch Poster
blocks.description: A high-end cinematic prompt designed for luxury sports advertising, featuring a central subject with dynamic digital glitch effects and futuristic UI elements against an intense red backdrop.
blocks.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium cinematic sports-fashion poster featuring {argument name="subject" default="a professional athlete"}, standing confidently in a full-body pose against a solid intense crimson-red background. The subject is centered slightly left, with a powerful editorial attitude and direct confident expression. Use a dramatic high-fashion sports campaign aesthetic, predominantly black and deep red tones, strong contrast, sharp details, and moody studio lighting.
Add a dynamic digital glitch / horizontal motion-distortion effect across the subject, as if parts of the clothing and body are rapidly stretching and dissolving toward the right side. The distortion should consist of sharp horizontal red, black, and dark crimson streaks, creating a feeling of extreme speed and motion while keeping the face clearly recognizable and undistorted.
Composition: full-body vertical poster, subject occupying most of the frame, generous negative space around the body, clean red background, low-to-medium camera angle, strong symmetrical visual balance, editorial fashion photography composition.
Typography and graphic design: add minimal futuristic sports-branding graphics around the subject — small technical markings, crosshair symbols, thin lines, micro typography, numbers, barcode elements, coordinates, subtle UI/HUD details, and small labels. Keep the typography elegant, minimal and secondary to the subject.
Texture: premium printed-poster aesthetic, subtle film grain, distressed paper texture, tiny scratches, slightly faded edges, analog print imperfections, subtle chromatic aberration, realistic shadows, high-end commercial photography.
Lighting: dramatic directional studio lighting, hard rim light around the silhouette, deep blacks, rich crimson highlights, realistic fabric reflections, cinematic contrast, controlled shadows.
Visual style: luxury sports campaign + futuristic editorial magazine + experimental fashion photography + digital glitch art. Photorealistic subject, realistic skin texture, realistic clothing folds, physically believable distortion, extremely detailed, sharp facial features, premium advertising quality, 8K, HDR.
Important: keep the subject's face, identity, facial proportions, hairstyle and overall appearance natural and recognizable. Do not distort the face. The glitch effect should primarily affect the clothing/body silhouette and extend horizontally toward the right.
Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical, high-end Instagram advertising poster, professional art direction, clean composition, no unnecessary objects.

blocks.title: No. 101: 电商主图 - Traditional Stewed Pear Dessert Poster
blocks.description: A detailed macro photography prompt for a Chinese-style dessert poster featuring snow pears in a glass pot with warm morning light and elegant typography.
blocks.prompt: A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of translucent snow pear from a stewing pot, with clear syrup forming a small backflow along the tip of the spoon. Design a 3:4 vertical rock sugar stewed pear poster for an original nourishing dessert brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}". The scene is set exclusively on a warm white stone window sill on an autumn morning. A 15cm diameter transparent heat-resistant glass stewing pot is placed slightly to the right of the center, with the glass lid lying flat to the back left. The pot is 70% full of clear light-gold syrup, precisely containing eight pieces of cut snow pear, six pieces of transparent rock sugar, and three dried osmanthus flowers. A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of pear from the right, stopping about 4cm above the rim of the pot, with the syrup backflow controlled at 3cm. The center of the pot is at 62% horizontal and 64% vertical, occupying about 38% of the frame width. The area from 7% to 42% horizontal and 9% to 47% vertical on the left remains a warm white text zone. The foreground contains only half a fresh snow pear with the cut side facing up, while the background features a soft white sheer curtain; do not add red dates, wolfberries, or tremella. The camera is 12cm above the middle of the pot, using a 90mm macro lens shooting from the front left at a 14-degree angle from a distance of 72cm. The focus is locked on the pear fibers in the spoon, the transparency of the syrup, and the edge of the glass pot, with the lid remaining recognizable. A large window-shaped soft light of about 5500K from the back left penetrates the syrup and pear meat, while a warm white reflector at the front right restores the glass contours. blocks.title: No. 102: 电商主图 - Mesh Top and Checkered Skirt Outfit
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion generation prompt for a classical girlie look, detailing the fabric textures, seams, and construction of a mesh knit crop top and a checkered A-line mini skirt.
blocks.prompt: Wardrobe: Top: One solid muted cocoa-taupe sleeveless mock-neck crop top made from a fine-gauge stretch mesh knit with tightly regular micro-openings, a lightweight semi-sheer section, a smooth low-luster face, soft close drape, and resilient multidirectional recovery. Cut a close straight-to-lightly-tapered body ending at the upper waist, with matching front and rear lower-edge levels and minimal bulk. Form a narrow circular self-fabric mock neck whose finished height is between one-tenth and one-sixth of the shoulder-to-hem length, using a double-layer return and one low-bulk rear join. Continue two narrow shoulder sections into high-cut sleeveless armholes and uninterrupted front and rear body panels. Finish both armhole circuits with narrow self-fabric turned bindings less than one-tenth of the shoulder-section width, join the body through two clean side seams, and complete the lower circumference with one narrow straight double-turn hem. Use the knit recovery and complete neck opening for a pull-on construction without exterior fastening. Keep the mesh scale evenly legible, the semi-sheer density consistent, the mock neck softly upright, the armhole edges flat, and the lower hem free of heavy opaque bulk. Bottom: One camel-tan wrap-front mini skirt made from medium-weight brushed twill with a compact diagonal weave, a short soft nap, a matte low-luster surface, firm shape retention, and rounded low-bulk folds; confine espresso brown, ivory, and muted dusty-rose to the woven geometric check and matte black to two front buttons. Cut a high-rise upper-thigh mini length with a close waist and upper hip, then widen gently into a compact A-line hem whose laid-flat width is between one-and-one-fifth and one-and-two-fifths of the top-edge width. Form a clean curved faced upper edge without a separate exterior waistband. Build smooth front and rear bodies with two equal rear waist darts, one at product-right and one at product-left, two side seams, and one full-height product-left front overlap panel spanning between one-half and two-thirds of the front width; keep its vertical free edge straight from the top edge to the hem and its underlap continuous behind it. Cover every front, overlap, side, and rear panel with a woven repeat of large upright camel rectangles bounded by single espresso lines and paired ivory lines, then add one fine dusty-rose pinstripe only to alternating vertical and horizontal corridors so the rose intersections shift by one cell on every second row; each complete repeat spans between one-quarter and one-third of the laid-flat front width, with straight orthogonal lines and clean registration across darts, seams, and the overlap. Mount two circular matte-black four-hole buttons in one vertical product-left-front line, each between one-tenth and one-eighth of the waist-to-hem depth in diameter; place the upper station within the upper quarter of that depth and the lower station between one-half and two-thirds of the depth. Secure the overlap through two matching reinforced buttonholes on the underlap, keeping both stations fully engaged and the panel flat, and finish the complete lower edge with one narrow turned hem. Preserve the short brushed nap, readable diagonal weave, crisp A-line outline, stable overlap depth, aligned geometric repeat, flat button seating, and material-correct hem thickness. Footwear: One matching pair of predominantly black combat boots built from medium-thick semi-matte coated leather-like upper material with a fine shallow grain and broad flexible crease response, black flat woven cord, silver-tone metal, and deep black molded rubber. Each boot is knee-high with a tall straight shaft, a broad rounded toe, a substantial forefoot platform, and a slightly deeper rear block, with shaft volume remaining open and stable near the top before compressing into broad slouch folds through the lower shaft and ankle. A wide straight topline forms the shaft opening and retains a clean finished edge. The upper consists of tall side and rear shaft panels joined to a rounded forefoot, broad vamp, quarters, and a central tongue; the vamp stays close while the shaft carries relaxed vertical volume. Paired rows of black lace holes run from the forefoot into the lower shaft and hold flat black laces, while two separate narrow wrap straps encircle each boot, one near the upper shaft and one at the ankle, each ending at its own compact rectangular silver-tone buckle. Tonal topstitching defines the panel joins, and the sole forms a thick continuous sidewall above a deeply cut lugged contact face. The laces close in compact tied bows and both buckle straps remain fastened through their rectangular frames. Both boots are identical anatomical mirror counterparts with the same panel layout, lace path, strap count, buckle placement, shaft height, slouch distribution, toe shape, and sole stack. Preserve the coated fine grain through the broad folds, keep the two buckle circuits physically separate from the lace closure, and maintain crisp sole edges, deep lug relief, firm toe volume, and material-correct seam bulk. Bag: Styling — highest priority: - Bag carry: Hang the strap from the wearer-right shoulder only without crossing the chest, and let the bag body lie flat along the right flank between the lower ribs and outer hip. Let the strap bear the full weight and keep both hands off the bag and strap. Keep the complete strap and bag body entirely outside and visibly separate from every garment, routing the strap over, never beneath or through, the outermost clothing. Do not pass it through any neckline, sleeve, knit opening, seam, or rear panel, and do not merge, attach, weave, replace, or reinterpret any bag material as part of a garment. - Finish — Natural: Adjust only material-correct slack and body contact along the exact selected strap route. Keep the selected route and all attachment points exact while allowing limited material-correct slack and natural body contact. One warm-ivory soft gathered chain-strap pouch bag made from lightweight lightly padded matte woven fabric, constructed as one medium rounded crescent-like body with softly tapered upper corners, a broad curved lower edge, shallow expandable side depth, and controlled flexible volume. Gather the complete upper body into one reinforced top-edge opening, producing repeated soft vertical folds that release through the front, rear, and side surfaces without rigid quilting lines. Add one long warm-gold-tone curb-chain strap attached through two small polished gold-tone D-rings and reinforced matching fabric tabs at the upper sides, preserving identical attachment height and hardware construction on both ends. Complete the front, rear, side panels, curved base, gathered upper edge, reinforced top opening, chain strap, D-rings, attachment tabs, hidden seam allowances, and internal soft support as one coherent bag with no visible exterior closure hardware, exterior pocket, readable branding, detachable charm, keychain, plush ornament, mascot, or additional decoration. Preserve lightweight textile response, softly padded body volume, even gather distribution, clean upper-edge reinforcement, secure chain anchoring, low seam bulk, and restrained warm-gold reflections. Necklace: One short silver fine-chain necklace built as one continuous closed circuit with a shallow curved ornament centered on one product axis. Keep most of the circuit as a slender uniform chain and confine the ornament to a short lower arc substantially shorter than the complete chain path. Construct the ornament from a closely spaced row of uniform short rounded cylindrical beads aligned radially to form a gentle crescent, connecting both ornament terminals directly into compact polished chain links. Maintain bilateral orn

blocks.title: No. 106: 电商主图 - Pinstriped Button-Up Shirt Design
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion prompt detailing the construction, styling, and embroidery of a cropped pinstriped shirt with rolled sleeves and botanical threadwork.
blocks.prompt: ワードローブ： トップス： スタイリング： - フロントクロージャー：フロント中央のクロージャーの上部約3分の1だけを開け、胸より下のクロージャーはすべて裾まで留めたままにする。上部の開口部は左右対称に保つ。開口部を下部まで広げたり、上部を閉じ直したりしない。 - 袖：各袖口を外側にちょうど2回折り返し、両腕にダブルロールのバンドを作る。両方のバンドを前腕の中ほど、肘の折り目より下で手首より上の位置に配置する。他のスタイリング指示で衣服が肩から下がった場合でも、この巻き数と高さを維持する。袖を肘まで押し上げたり、袖口を隠したりしない。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル： - フロントクロージャー：選択した上部開口部のみを外し、下の留め具はすべて留めたままにする。その間隔を変更せず、固定された留め状態に隣接するパネルのドレープのみを調整する。 - 袖：選択した数、位置、向き、レイヤー順序を変更しない。固定された袖の高さより下のロール構造のみを調整し、元の袖口を保持する。適度な重なりとわずかな非対称性を持つ柔らかい折り目を使用する。 淡いスカイブルーと白の垂直ピンストライプの長袖クロップドボタンアップシャツ。軽量なポプリン風の織物で、パリッとしたマットな質感。ボクシーなシルエットで、ウエストより上で終わる裾を持つ。白いポインテッドカラーと、小さな白いボタンが並ぶフロント前立てを備える。袖山に軽いギャザーがあり、広いピンストライプのバレルカフスはボタンで閉じられている。左胸にパッチポケットがあり、全体に白い植物風の刺繍やオープンワークが施されている。左胸ポケットには、半透明の花びらのアップリケやビーズを用いた立体的な装飾が集中している。ジッパーや余計な装飾のない、一貫したデザインのシャツである。 ボトムス：淡いクールグレーのハイライズフレアミニスカート。中重量のコンパクトなポンチニット製で、マットな質感。太もも上部丈のスケーターシルエット。伸縮性のあるアッパーバンドを備え、複数のパネルとシームラインで構成されている。ポケットやジッパーのないプルオンタイプで、素材の厚みと放射状のフレアを維持している。 レッグウェア：温かみのある白のショートクルーソックス。上質な垂直リブニット製で、左右対称の設計。リブ編みのアッパーカフと補強されたかかと・つま先を持ち、装飾のないシンプルなデザイン。適度な不透明度とストレッチ性を備えている。 フットウェア：温かみのあるアイボリーのロートップチャンキーレザースニーカー。丸いつま先と厚いプラットフォームソールが特徴。アッパーはスエード調の素材とオフホワイトのメッシュを組み合わせ、幾何学的なオーバーレイを配置。オフホワイトの靴紐が左右対称に通されている。頑丈なラグトレッドを備えた厚底ソールを持ち、細部まで一貫した配色と質感で仕上げられている。 バッグ： スタイリング： - バッグの持ち方：ストラップを左肩からのみ下げ、バッグ本体を左脇腹に置く。胸を横切らせず、手は添えない。バッグとストラップは衣服の外側に完全に露出させ、衣服の下や中を通さないこと。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル：選択したストラップのルートに沿って、素材に忠実な緩みと体への接触のみを調整する。選択したルートとすべての取り付けを維持する。

blocks.prompt: ワードローブ： トップス： スタイリング： - フロントクロージャー：フロント中央のクロージャーの上部約3分の1だけを開け、胸より下のクロージャーはすべて裾まで留めたままにする。上部の開口部は左右対称に保つ。開口部を下部まで広げたり、上部を閉じ直したりしない。 - 袖：各袖口を外側にちょうど2回折り返し、両腕にダブルロールのバンドを作る。両方のバンドを前腕の中ほど、肘の折り目より下で手首より上の位置に配置する。他のスタイリング指示で衣服が肩から下がった場合でも、この巻き数と高さを維持する。袖を肘まで押し上げたり、袖口を隠したりしない。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル： - フロントクロージャー：選択した上部開口部のみを外し、下の留め具はすべて留めたままにする。その間隔を変更せず、固定された留め状態に隣接するパネルのドレープのみを調整する。 - 袖：選択した数、位置、向き、レイヤー順序を変更しない。固定された袖の高さより下のロール構造のみを調整し、元の袖口を保持する。適度な重なりとわずかな非対称性を持つ柔らかい折り目を使用する。 淡いスカイブルーと白の垂直ピンストライプの長袖クロップドボタンアップシャツ。軽量なポプリン風の織物で、パリッとしたマットな質感。ボクシーなシルエットで、ウエストより上で終わる裾を持つ。白いポインテッドカラーと、小さな白いボタンが並ぶフロント前立てを備える。袖山に軽いギャザーがあり、広いピンストライプのバレルカフスはボタンで閉じられている。左胸にパッチポケットがあり、全体に白い植物風の刺繍やオープンワークが施されている。左胸ポケットには、半透明の花びらのアップリケやビーズを用いた立体的な装飾が集中している。ジッパーや余計な装飾のない、一貫したデザインのシャツである。 ボトムス：淡いクールグレーのハイライズフレアミニスカート。中重量のコンパクトなポンチニット製で、マットな質感。太もも上部丈のスケーターシルエット。伸縮性のあるアッパーバンドを備え、複数のパネルとシームラインで構成されている。ポケットやジッパーのないプルオンタイプで、素材の厚みと放射状のフレアを維持している。 レッグウェア：温かみのある白のショートクルーソックス。上質な垂直リブニット製で、左右対称の設計。リブ編みのアッパーカフと補強されたかかと・つま先を持ち、装飾のないシンプルなデザイン。適度な不透明度とストレッチ性を備えている。 フットウェア：温かみのあるアイボリーのロートップチャンキーレザースニーカー。丸いつま先と厚いプラットフォームソールが特徴。アッパーはスエード調の素材とオフホワイトのメッシュを組み合わせ、幾何学的なオーバーレイを配置。オフホワイトの靴紐が左右対称に通されている。頑丈なラグトレッドを備えた厚底ソールを持ち、細部まで一貫した配色と質感で仕上げられている。 バッグ： スタイリング： - バッグの持ち方：ストラップを左肩からのみ下げ、バッグ本体を左脇腹に置く。胸を横切らせず、手は添えない。バッグとストラップは衣服の外側に完全に露出させ、衣服の下や中を通さないこと。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル：選択したストラップのルートに沿って、素材に忠実な緩みと体への接触のみを調整する。選択したルートとすべての取り付けを維持する。

blocks.title: No. 115: 电商主图 - 禅意乌龙茶电商详情页
blocks.description: 一份精心设计的提示词，旨在为概念茶品牌生成高端移动端优先的电商详情页，遵循具有禅意美学的结构化客户转化路径。
blocks.prompt:
为概念品牌“{argument name="brand name" default="LANXU"}”设计一个高端移动端优先的电商详情页，针对“{argument name="product name" default="高山乌龙茶"}”打造完整的转化路径。该产品为两罐装礼盒，每罐净含量为“{argument name="net content" default="100g"}”。
严格保持一致性：品牌“LANXU”，两罐圆柱形金属茶罐（高约 135mm，直径 78mm），采用岩灰色哑光饰面，配以古铜色盖子。垂直品牌标识“LANXU”和产品标签在两个罐子上必须完全一致。视觉系统：“禅意奢华 + 自然有机”，核心概念“杯中云雾”。配色方案：岩灰、雾白、芽绿、琥珀茶色和氧化铜色。图形语言：抽象的山谷轮廓、稀薄的晨雾和扩散的茶汤层次。排版：现代宋体搭配简洁的无衬线字体，留白充裕。
布局：宽度约 1242px，垂直长图（比例 1:5）。包含七个连续模块：
1. “核心价值”：两罐茶叶与礼盒置于抽象的云雾山谷背景中，标题为“杯中云雾”。
2. “饮用价值”：干茶、叶底和清澈琥珀茶汤的微距摄影，标注“风味特征：以实际测评为准”。
3. “产地与原料”：抽象的茶园坡地与采摘细节，预留产地和海拔信息位置。
4. “制作工艺”：四个步骤（采摘、萎凋、烘焙、包装），预留工艺名称位置。
5. “冲泡体验”：白瓷盖碗、公道杯和注茶的写实场景；预留温度和时间信息位置。
6. “包装与规格”：清晰展示礼盒、两罐茶叶、开启状态及“100g x 2 罐”标签。
7. “购买信任”：礼赠场景、规格占位符及物流信息。
风格：结合真实商业摄影与精致平面设计的高端电商艺术指导。所有物品必须具备真实的比例和接触点。茶叶不得悬浮，雾气不得遮挡产品可见度。
仅展示核心文本：“LANXU”、“高山乌龙”、“杯中云雾”、“原叶形态”、“风味特征：占位符”、“产地信息：占位符”、“工艺信息：占位符”、“冲泡建议：占位符”、“100g x 2 罐”、“产品信息：占位符”。

blocks.description: This prompt generates a soft, airy portrait of a woman inside a train car, holding onto a strap while being illuminated by gentle window light. It captures textures of a pleated blouse and the metallic train interior.

Train strap in window light
Main Subject:
A vertical upper-body photo of a single woman in a bright train car, raising her right arm to hold a round strap. A {argument name="top color" default="white sleeveless blouse"}, {argument name="bottom color" default="dark navy pleated skirt"}, and red seats are visible.

Face tilted slightly to the left, large brown eyes directed at the camera, smiling gently with closed lips. Slightly long oval face with a small round chin, rounded almond-shaped eyes, thin gentle eyebrows, slender nose bridge and small tip, pale rose lips with a thinner upper lip and a thicker lower lip. Bright skin with natural light makeup. {argument name="hair color" default="Dark brown"} shoulder-length hair with a center-ish part, thin bangs, and ends lightly flowing outward.

White round-neck thin collar, sleeveless blouse with fine vertical pleats and transparency. High-waisted dark navy pleated skirt. The person's own left arm (screen right) bent overhead to grip a gray circular strap, right arm lowered to the side. Upper body tilted slightly to the left.
Background/Light:
Metal vertical pole and other straps on the left, a red bench at the bottom, large car window and silver frame on the right. Soft white main light coming through the window from the right brightly illuminates the face, arm, and white cloth, while the outdoor background is blurred with high exposure.

3:4 vertical, close-up portrait from the hand above the head to below the waist at almost eye level. The person occupies the center largely, the raised arm creating a diagonal line to the top right, and the skirt is cropped at the bottom edge. Focus on the face, with the train interior softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

A clean photorealistic live-action photo. High-definition depiction of thin pleated fabric, skin, metal, window glass, and red seats, finished lightly with white natural light.

blocks.title: No. 33: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Glad2Glow Skincare Storyboard
blocks.description: A photorealistic 8-panel social media storyboard for a Glad2Glow glycolic facial wash routine and benefits ad.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a bright, ultra-realistic vertical skincare commercial storyboard for {argument name="product name" default="Glad2Glow Glycolic Acid Facial Wash"}, showing a complete cleansing routine from product reveal to foam, rinse, glow result, and benefit checklist.
Canvas: 16:9 landscape storyboard sheet divided into exactly 8 rounded rectangular panels in a 2-row by 4-column grid, with thin white gutters between panels. Use a soft beige luxury bathroom setting, warm morning sunlight, shallow depth of field, creamy highlights, and a fresh green-and-cream color palette. Add a small bottom caption centered under the grid: “10 SAAT STORYBOARD – Glad2Glow Glycolic Acid Facial Wash”.
Visual style: Premium cinematic skincare ad, photorealistic hands and skin, glossy gel texture, rich white foam, soft sparkle doodles, small hand-drawn hearts, water drops, bubbles, and cute sticker-like labels. Keep the look clean, youthful, airy, and social-media friendly.
Layout and panel count: Include exactly 8 numbered panels, each with a small white circle number badge at the top-left: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
Panel details:
1. Product hero: A hand in a cream ribbed sweater holds a pale green squeeze tube of Glad2Glow facial wash upright in front of a blurred beige bathroom and plant leaves. Add a small white heart doodle. Sticker text: “Pencuci muka kegemaran!”
2. Flip cap opening: Close-up of the green tube tilted downward, cap flipped open, with gel beginning to dispense. Add animated motion lines, bubbles, hearts, and a sticker label reading: “Flip & squeeze senang sangat!”
3. Gel texture: Close-up of translucent gel being squeezed onto an open palm, showing soft, smooth gel. Add small bubble and flower doodles. Sticker text: “Gel lembut buih halus”.
4. Foam lather: Close-up of both hands covered in dense white foam, wet and sparkling. Add bright star glints. Sticker text: “Bersih mendalam tanpa keringkan kulit!”
5. Face cleansing: Side close-up of a cheek and jawline with cleanser foam being massaged across the skin, implying removal of makeup and dirt. Add sparkle and star doodles. Sticker text: “Angkat minyak & kotoran dengan mudah!”
6. Rinsing: Two cupped wet hands with water droplets in a sink area, clean and refreshed. Add water-drop doodles. Sticker text: “Bilas bersih, kulit rasa segar!”
7. Final glow product shot: Hand in cream sweater holds the green tube again in a softly lit bathroom with flowers in the background. Add a pink heart doodle. Sticker text: “Kulit cerah berseri”.
8. Benefits card: A pale green rectangular checklist card on a green background with a decorative white dashed border at the top. Headline: “Kenapa wajib cuba?” Include exactly 4 checklist items: “Gel Cleanser”, “Glycolic Acid”, “Low pH Formula”, “Sesuai untuk semua jenis kulit”. Add bold section text: “Glow setiap hari!” and smaller text: “Kulit bersih, cerah & sihat”. Include a simple smiling face doodle and sparkles.
Subject details: The product tube should be pastel lime green with dark green vertical “glad2glow” branding, a translucent green flip cap, and small label text suggesting glycolic acid facial wash. Hands should look natural, soft, clean, and well-lit.
Constraints: Use exactly 8 panels and exactly the visible Malay sticker/checklist text listed above. Do not add extra panels, extra checklist items, logos from other brands, watermarks, or unrelated props. Keep the product legible and consistent in all product panels.

blocks.title: No. 34: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Hot Air Balloon Vlog Storyboard
blocks.description: Generates a professional 6-scene cinematic storyboard infographic for a 30-second sunrise hot-air-balloon travel vlog.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, information-dense storyboard infographic for a travel vlog titled {argument name="headline text" default="30-SECOND ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC TRAVEL VLOG - STORYBOARD"}, showing a cinematic hot-air-balloon adventure at sunrise with one consistent female protagonist.
Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet on a white background with thin black/gray grid lines, like a professional production planning board. Use a bold centered all-caps headline across the top. Arrange the main content in exactly 6 numbered scene cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, with a lower technical notes strip spanning the full width.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic travel documentary stills, 4K HDR feel, golden sunrise light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, warm atmospheric haze, natural wind movement, professional camera quality. The setting is a beautiful hot-air-balloon launch site and aerial valley landscape with vineyards, winding rivers, mountains, villages, baskets, burner flames, and many colorful balloons.
Main character: Use one female protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="the same young woman throughout"}, with shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm medium skin tone, soft oval face, and a friendly smile. She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.
Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.
Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:
1. Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Notes: Scene/action: drone wide reveal of balloons at sunrise; cut to walking selfie as she approaches the launch field, smiling. Dialogue: {argument name="opening dialogue" default="Good morning! Today we're finally going on a hot air balloon adventure!"}
2. Preparing for Takeoff (4–8 sec): four thumbnails showing colorful balloon fabric inflating, realistic burner flames, the woman watching excitedly beside the balloon, and her near/inside the basket. Notes: crew inflates balloons, burner fires, she talks to pilot, watches balloon expand, and steps into the basket. Dialogue: “I can't believe how massive these balloons are up close!” Camera/movement: wide, close-up burner, gimbal follow, POV entering basket.
3. Lift-Off (8–13 sec): three thumbnails showing a close-up portrait of the woman, a side profile at the basket rail, and a wide aerial landscape with balloons floating. Notes: balloon lifts off, she records selfie and looks over edge as the landscape shrinks below. Dialogue: “We're actually floating... this is unbelievable!” Camera/movement: selfie, drone orbit, over-shoulder, wide aerial shot.
4. Floating Above the Valley (13–18 sec): three thumbnails showing a high aerial valley with river and balloons, a close portrait in the basket, and a POV view over vineyards and villages. Notes: golden sunlight over valley, rivers, vineyards, and hills; she admires the view and points at distant balloons. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Notes: she takes photos, waves to other ballooners, and enjoys peaceful mid-flight moments. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.
6. Landing & Farewell (24–30 sec): three thumbnails showing the balloon landing with crew silhouettes, a smiling farewell portrait, and a final aerial view of balloons in the sunrise haze. Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.
Bottom technical strip: Include exactly 5 labeled information boxes across the bottom plus a small centered character portrait near the identity box. The 5 boxes are: Camera & Cinematography, Audio, Environment, Character (Locked Identity), and Negative Prompt. Fill them with compact bullet-style text: Sony FX3, RED V-Raptor, DJI Ronin 4D, DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, 24mm/35mm/50mm/65mm lenses, handheld/gimbal/drone/POV/orbit, 4K HDR, shallow DOF, natural light; natural dialogue, wind, burner flames, birds, crew conversations, basket creaks, footsteps, soft cinematic orchestral music; sunrise hot-air balloon site, colorful balloons, wicker baskets, burners, valleys, rivers, vineyards, mountains, golden-hour light, realistic weather and atmosphere; use uploaded reference as single source, same face/hair/skin tone/makeup, ivory dress and beige cardigan, natural expressions only, no identity drift or wardrobe changes; no face distortion, no identity drift, no duplicate characters, no broken anatomy, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no flickering, no frame warping, no inconsistent wardrobe, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no timestamps, no UI overlays.
Constraints: The final image must read as a polished production storyboard, not a movie poster. Keep all 6 scene cards visible and numbered, keep the bottom 5 technical boxes, use consistent typography, preserve the same woman and outfit in every thumbnail, and avoid adding extra scenes or extra characters as protagonists.

blocks.title: No. 39: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - DNA Nucleotides 3D Infographic
blocks.description: A detailed 3D educational biology infographic showing a labeled DNA double helix with nucleotide base pairs, hydrogen bonds, backbone, and emerging RNA.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 3D scientific educational infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="DNA Nucleotides"}, showing a close-up view of a DNA double helix with labeled nucleotide bases and molecular structure.
Canvas: Landscape 4:3 composition, bright white laboratory-style background with soft depth-of-field molecular clusters in pale blue, lavender, mint, and purple around the edges. Use a clean, high-resolution textbook/medical visualization style with realistic glossy translucent spheres and rods, soft shadows, and shallow depth of field.
Layout: Center the title at the top in large dark navy bold type, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="A close-up view of the DNA double helix"} directly beneath in smaller medium-blue type. Fill the frame with a large twisting DNA double helix running from the left foreground through the center to the right side, with a second orange strand crossing diagonally through the lower right foreground. Keep the central base-pair region open and readable for labels.
Subject details: Render the DNA as a molecular ball-and-stick model combined with translucent bead-like backbone surfaces. The sugar-phosphate backbone should be two twisting chains made of semi-transparent bluish-gray spheres with orange/gold connector rods and small red atoms. In the center, show exactly 4 labeled nucleotide bases: Adenine (A) in green at upper left center, Thymine (T) in purple at upper right center, Guanine (G) in blue at lower left center, and Cytosine (C) in orange at lower right center. Adenine pairs with Thymine across the top using dotted pale blue hydrogen bonds, and Guanine pairs with Cytosine below using three dotted pale blue hydrogen-bond rows. Molecular rings should be flat aromatic ring structures with small colored atom spheres and white hydrogen atoms.
Text content and labels: Include exactly 7 callout labels with thin black pointer lines: “Adenine (A)” in green pointing to the green upper-left base; “Thymine (T)” in purple pointing to the purple upper-right base; “Guanine (G)” in blue pointing to the blue lower-left base; “Cytosine (C)” in orange pointing to the orange lower-right base; “Sugar-phosphate backbone” in black pointing to the right-side helical backbone; “Hydrogen bonds” in black pointing to the dotted bond lines between base pairs; and “Emerging RNA” in orange pointing to the orange strand crossing the lower foreground. Use crisp sans-serif typography and avoid crowding.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed scientific 3D render, glossy translucent molecular beads, realistic refraction, soft bokeh background, professional biology textbook infographic, balanced educational clarity and cinematic depth.
Constraints: Use exactly the 4 nucleotide labels and exactly the 3 structural labels listed above; do not add extra labels, icons, captions, legends, watermarks, or borders. Keep all text sharp and correctly spelled.

blocks.title: No. 41: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Chinese Home Compute Buying Guide
blocks.description: A vertical Chinese infographic comparing four home computing purchase options with prices, power usage, audiences, and drawbacks.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese product comparison infographic on a white background with a clean flat-design style. The main title at the top is {argument name="headline text" default="2026 家庭算力采购指南"}, in large bold black Chinese type, centered.

Footer: Center a small gray footnote along the bottom: “数据仅供参考 · 更新于 2026-08-08 · 非投资建议”.
